"""Forensic report generator worker synthesizing investigation findings."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid

from vigil.domain.report import Report
from vigil.orchestration.task_types import TaskRequest
from vigil.storage.repository import EntityNotFoundError
from vigil.tools.base import BaseToolWorker
from vigil.tools.visual_detector import normalize_observation_description

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _format_timecode(seconds: float | None) -> str:
    """Format seconds into MM:SS.ss timecode."""
    if seconds is None:
        return "N/A"
    mins = int(seconds // 60)
    secs = seconds % 60
    return f"{mins:02d}:{secs:05.2f}"


def _clean_summary_output(text: str) -> str:
    """Clean markdown artifacts, code fence wrappers, or raw echoes from LLM summary."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    cleaned = text.strip()
    if cleaned.startswith("```markdown"):
        cleaned = cleaned[len("```markdown"):].strip()
    elif cleaned.startswith("```"):
        cleaned = cleaned[len("```"):].strip()
    if cleaned.endswith("```"):
        cleaned = cleaned[:-3].strip()
    return cleaned


class ReportGeneratorWorker(BaseToolWorker):
    """Compiles observations, events, assessments, and coverage into a structured Report."""

    def run(self, request: TaskRequest) -> list[str]:
        investigation_id = str(
            request.parameters.get("investigation_id", "inv-default")
        )
        title = str(
            request.parameters.get(
                "title", f"Forensic Investigation Report: {investigation_id}"
            )
        )

        # Retrieve investigation details if available
        inv_title = title
        media_asset_ids: list[str] = []
        try:
            inv = self.repository.get_investigation(investigation_id)
            objective = inv.objective or "Forensic timeline and activity verification."
            inv_title = inv.title or title
            media_asset_ids = list(inv.media_asset_ids)
        except EntityNotFoundError:
            objective = "Forensic timeline and activity verification."

        # Collect scoped references for THIS investigation
        state = self.repository.get_state(investigation_id)
        if state is not None:
            obs_ids = list(state.observation_ids)
            event_ids = list(state.event_ids)
        else:
            obs_ids = []
            event_ids = []

        # If state did not track observations yet, check media asset references
        if not obs_ids and media_asset_ids:
            all_obs = self.repository.list_observations()
            for o in all_obs:
                if any(sr.media_asset_id in media_asset_ids for sr in o.source_references):
                    obs_ids.append(o.observation_id)

        # Retrieve scoped records
        observations = self.repository.list_observations(obs_ids) if obs_ids else []
        events = self.repository.list_events(event_ids) if event_ids else []

        # Filter assessments strictly targeting this case's events or observations
        target_ids = set(event_ids) | set(obs_ids)
        all_assessments = self.repository.list_evidence_assessments()
        assessments = [a for a in all_assessments if a.target_id in target_ids]
        assessment_ids = [a.assessment_id for a in assessments]

        coverages = self.repository.list_coverage_records(investigation_id)
        coverage_ids = [c.coverage_id for c in coverages]

        # Gather all media assets and camera information
        all_repo_assets = {m.media_asset_id: m for m in self.repository.list_media_assets()}
        all_media = [all_repo_assets[mid] for mid in media_asset_ids if mid in all_repo_assets]
        camera_map = {c.camera_id: c for c in self.repository.list_cameras()}

        media_context_lines = []
        for m in all_media:
            cam_info = ""
            if m.camera_id and m.camera_id in camera_map:
                c = camera_map[m.camera_id]
                cam_info = f" [Camera: {c.camera_id} - {c.location_label or c.name}]"
            elif m.camera_id:
                cam_info = f" [Camera: {m.camera_id}]"
            dur_str = f"{m.duration_seconds:.1f}s" if m.duration_seconds else "N/A"
            media_context_lines.append(f"- Media Asset '{m.media_asset_id}'{cam_info}: Duration {dur_str}")
        media_context = "\n".join(media_context_lines) if media_context_lines else "- Single primary surveillance feed"

        # Chronological ordering of events
        sorted_events = sorted(
            events,
            key=lambda e: (e.start_seconds if e.start_seconds is not None else 0.0),
        )

        events_summary_lines: list[str] = []
        for e in sorted_events:
            t_str = ""
            if e.start_seconds is not None and e.end_seconds is not None:
                t_str = f"[{_format_timecode(e.start_seconds)} - {_format_timecode(e.end_seconds)} ({e.start_seconds:.1f}s - {e.end_seconds:.1f}s)]"
            elif e.start_seconds is not None:
                t_str = f"[{e.start_seconds:.1f}s]"
            events_summary_lines.append(
                f"- {t_str} Event: {e.event_type} (Status: {e.status}) — {e.description} (Supporting observations: {len(e.observation_ids)})"
            )
        events_context = "\n".join(events_summary_lines) if events_summary_lines else "No discrete correlated events."

        # Scoped entities context
        all_entities = self.repository.list_entities()
        scoped_entities = [
            e for e in all_entities
            if any(oid in set(obs_ids) for oid in e.associated_observation_ids)
        ]
        entities_summary_lines: list[str] = []
        for ent in scoped_entities[:20]:
            attrs_str = ", ".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in ent.attributes.items() if v)
            entities_summary_lines.append(
                f"- Entity #{ent.entity_id} [{ent.entity_type.upper()}]: Label '{ent.label or 'Unlabeled'}' | Attributes: {attrs_str or 'None'} | Linked Obs: {len(ent.associated_observation_ids)}"
            )
        entities_context = "\n".join(entities_summary_lines) if entities_summary_lines else "No entities reliably identified."

        obs_summary_lines: list[str] = []
        for o in observations[:25]:
            sr = o.source_references[0] if o.source_references else None
            t_str = ""
            if sr and sr.start_seconds is not None and sr.end_seconds is not None:
                t_str = f"[{_format_timecode(sr.start_seconds)} - {_format_timecode(sr.end_seconds)}]"
            elif sr and sr.start_seconds is not None:
                t_str = f"[{sr.start_seconds:.1f}s]"
            clean_desc = normalize_observation_description(o.description)
            obs_summary_lines.append(
                f"- {t_str} Modality: {o.modality} | Finding: {o.observation_type} | Conf: {o.confidence or 0.85:.2f} | {clean_desc}"
            )
        obs_context = "\n".join(obs_summary_lines) if obs_summary_lines else "No observations recorded."

        assessments_summary_lines: list[str] = []
        for a in assessments[:15]:
            assessments_summary_lines.append(
                f"- Target: {a.target_type}:{a.target_id} | Rating: {a.rating.upper()} | Dimension: {a.assessment_type} | Rationale: {a.rationale}"
            )
        assessments_context = "\n".join(assessments_summary_lines) if assessments_summary_lines else "No formal evidence assessments recorded."

        # Structured synthesis prompt
        prompt = (
            "You are a lead forensic investigator writing the official Executive Summary and Findings for a video-forensic report.\n\n"
            f"CASE INFORMATION:\n"
            f"- Title: {inv_title}\n"
            f"- Investigation Objective: '{objective}'\n\n"
            f"EXAMINED PREMISE CAMERA FEEDS ({len(all_media)} Feed(s)):\n"
            f"{media_context}\n\n"
            f"EXAMINED EVIDENCE SCOPE (STRICT DATA FOR THIS CASE):\n"
            f"- Observations count: {len(obs_ids)}\n"
            f"- Correlated Events count: {len(event_ids)}\n"
            f"- Evidence Assessments count: {len(assessment_ids)}\n"
            f"- Coverage Records count: {len(coverage_ids)}\n\n"
            f"CHRONOLOGICAL EVENT TIMELINE (ACROSS PREMISE FEEDS):\n{events_context}\n\n"
            f"DETECTED FORENSIC ENTITIES:\n{entities_context}\n\n"
            f"OBSERVATIONAL EVIDENCE:\n{obs_context}\n\n"
            f"EVIDENCE ASSESSMENTS:\n{assessments_context}\n\n"
            "INSTRUCTIONS:\n"
            "Write an authoritative, clear, and easy-to-interpret forensic investigation summary. "
            "Follow this exact structured format with markdown headers and bullet points:\n\n"
            "### 1. Objective Finding & Direct Answer\n"
            f"Provide a clear, decisive, and unambiguous answer to the Investigation Objective ('{objective}'). "
            "State the primary finding, counts of persons/entities, and verified conclusions immediately across all premise feeds.\n\n"
            "### 2. Chronological Timeline Analysis\n"
            "Detail the sequence of occurrences in chronological order using timestamp intervals [MM:SS or seconds]. "
            "Highlight entity movement and progression across different camera viewpoints and locations on the premise. "
            "Correlate visual and acoustic observations with physical actions.\n\n"
            "### 3. Evidence Integrity & Confidence\n"
            "Summarize the evidence quality, support level, and certainty of the findings based on the verified data.\n\n"
            "STRICT RULES:\n"
            f"- DO NOT hallucinate records or counts. The total observations examined is exactly {len(obs_ids)}, "
            f"the discrete events is {len(event_ids)}, and assessments is {len(assessment_ids)}.\n"
            "- Strictly ground all conclusions in the timestamped evidence provided above."
        )

        # Baseline fallback summary
        feed_note = f" across {len(all_media)} camera feeds" if len(all_media) > 1 else ""
        summary = (
            f"### 1. Objective Finding & Direct Answer\n"
            f"Forensic investigation completed for objective: '{objective}'. Analysis identified {len(event_ids)} "
            f"discrete events{feed_note} supported by {len(obs_ids)} observations.\n\n"
            f"### 2. Chronological Timeline Analysis\n"
            f"{events_context}\n\n"
            f"### 3. Evidence Integrity & Confidence\n"
            f"Examination covered {len(coverage_ids)} source records across {len(all_media) or 1} surveillance feeds with {len(assessment_ids)} formal evidence assessments."
        )

        try:
            response = self.llm.generate_text(prompt=prompt, json_mode=False)
            if response and response.content and response.content.strip():
                clean_content = _clean_summary_output(response.content)
                if len(clean_content) > 30:
                    summary = clean_content
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("ReportGeneratorWorker: LLM call failed (%s); using baseline summary.", exc)

        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Visual Evidence Selection & Localization (Feature A & B)
        # Select up to max_evidence_frames (default 3), localize entities, and
        # produce non-destructive derivative overlays.
        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        evidence_items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        evidence_artifact_ids: list[str] = []
        try:
            from vigil.config import config
            from vigil.tools.visual_annotator import VisualEvidenceAnnotator
            annotator = VisualEvidenceAnnotator(
                repository=self.repository,
                llm_client=self.llm,
            )
            default_limit = getattr(config, "report_max_evidence_frames", 3)
            max_evidence_frames = int(request.parameters.get("max_evidence_frames", default_limit))
            evidence_objs = annotator.prepare_visual_evidence(
                investigation_id=investigation_id,
                max_frames=max_evidence_frames,
            )
            for item in evidence_objs:
                evidence_items.append(item.model_dump())
                evidence_artifact_ids.append(item.artifact_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning(
                "ReportGeneratorWorker: Visual evidence preparation failed (%s); continuing without visual overlays.",
                exc,
            )

        report_id = f"rep-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        report = Report(
            report_id=report_id,
            investigation_id=investigation_id,
            title=title,
            summary=summary,
            observation_ids=obs_ids,
            event_ids=event_ids,
            assessment_ids=assessment_ids,
            coverage_ids=coverage_ids,
            evidence_frame_artifact_ids=evidence_artifact_ids,
            visual_evidence=evidence_items,
            generated_by=str(
                request.parameters.get("generated_by", "vigil-lead-investigator")
            ),
        )

        self.repository.add_report(report)
        return [report_id]

PATH - src\vigil\tools\visual_annotator.py
CODE:
"""Report-only visual evidence selection, bounding box localization, and annotation engine."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from vigil.domain.artifact import Artifact
from vigil.domain.entity import Entity
from vigil.domain.visual_evidence import (
    BoundingBox,
    VisualEvidenceItem,
    validate_coordinates,
)
from vigil.models.base import BaseLLMClient
from vigil.services.exporter import _uri_to_local_path
from vigil.storage.repository import InvestigationRepository
from vigil.tools.base import generate_sha256
from vigil.tools.visual_detector import clean_vlm_text, normalize_observation_description, resolve_or_create_entity

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Annotation cache version to invalidate stale schemas if format changes
ANNOTATION_CACHE_VERSION = "v1.0"


class VisualEvidenceAnnotator:
    """Manages report-only incident frame selection, VLM entity localization, and overlay rendering."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        repository: InvestigationRepository,
        llm_client: BaseLLMClient | None = None,
        storage_dir: Path | str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.repository = repository
        self.llm = llm_client
        self.storage_dir = Path(storage_dir).resolve() if storage_dir else Path("./storage_data").resolve()
        self._memory_cache: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def select_incident_frames(
        self,
        investigation_id: str,
        max_frames: int = 3,
    ) -> list[Artifact]:
        """Select up to max_frames informative incident-relevant frames using existing evidence and metadata.

        No new video extraction is performed; only existing extracted frame artifacts are evaluated.
        """
        try:
            inv = self.repository.get_investigation(investigation_id)
            target_media = set(inv.media_asset_ids)
            objective = (inv.objective or "").lower()
        except Exception:
            target_media = set()
            objective = ""

        all_artifacts = self.repository.list_artifacts()
        # Find candidate image/frame artifacts belonging to this investigation's media feeds
        candidates: list[Artifact] = []
        for art in all_artifacts:
            if art.media_type != "image" or art.artifact_type not in {"frame", "crop"}:
                continue
            if art.source_reference and target_media:
                if art.source_reference.media_asset_id in target_media:
                    candidates.append(art)
            elif not target_media:
                candidates.append(art)

        if not candidates:
            return []

        # Gather investigation context (events and observations)
        state = self.repository.get_state(investigation_id)
        scoped_event_ids = set(state.event_ids) if state else set()
        scoped_obs_ids = set(state.observation_ids) if state else set()

        events = self.repository.list_events(list(scoped_event_ids)) if scoped_event_ids else self.repository.list_events()
        observations = self.repository.list_observations(list(scoped_obs_ids)) if scoped_obs_ids else self.repository.list_observations()

        # Index observations by artifact_id
        obs_by_art: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
        for obs in observations:
            for aid in obs.artifact_ids:
                obs_by_art.setdefault(aid, []).append(obs)

        # Objective keywords for relevance matching
        obj_words = {
            w for w in objective.replace(",", " ").replace(".", " ").split()
            if len(w) > 3 and w not in {"what", "when", "where", "identify", "determine", "timeline", "forensic"}
        }

        # Score candidate frames
        scored_candidates: list[tuple[float, Artifact]] = []
        for art in candidates:
            score = 5.0  # Base score
            sr = art.source_reference
            frame_t = sr.start_seconds if sr else None

            # 1. Event overlap scoring
            for evt in events:
                evt_has_art = False
                for oid in evt.observation_ids:
                    matching_obs = [o for o in observations if o.observation_id == oid]
                    if any(art.artifact_id in o.artifact_ids for o in matching_obs):
                        evt_has_art = True
                        break

                t_overlap = False
                if frame_t is not None and evt.start_seconds is not None and evt.end_seconds is not None:
                    if evt.start_seconds - 0.5 <= frame_t <= evt.end_seconds + 0.5:
                        t_overlap = True

                if evt_has_art or t_overlap:
                    if evt.status == "confirmed":
                        score += 50.0
                    elif evt.status in {"proposed", "under_review"}:
                        score += 30.0
                    else:
                        score += 10.0

            # 2. Observation quality scoring
            linked_obs = obs_by_art.get(art.artifact_id, [])
            for obs in linked_obs:
                conf = obs.confidence if obs.confidence is not None else 0.8
                score += conf * 20.0
                if obs.observation_type in {"person_detection", "vehicle_detection", "visual_detection"}:
                    score += 15.0
                desc_lower = obs.description.lower()
                if any(kw in desc_lower for kw in obj_words):
                    score += 12.0

            scored_candidates.append((score, art))

        # Sort descending by score
        scored_candidates.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0], reverse=True)

        # Enforce diversity across camera feeds and temporal spacing (>= 1.5s apart on same feed)
        selected: list[Artifact] = []
        for _, art in scored_candidates:
            if len(selected) >= max_frames:
                break

            art_media = art.source_reference.media_asset_id if art.source_reference else "default"
            art_t = art.source_reference.start_seconds if art.source_reference else 0.0

            # Check spacing with already selected frames from the same media asset
            too_close = False
            for s in selected:
                s_media = s.source_reference.media_asset_id if s.source_reference else "default"
                s_t = s.source_reference.start_seconds if s.source_reference else 0.0
                if art_media == s_media and art_t is not None and s_t is not None:
                    if abs(art_t - s_t) < 1.5:
                        too_close = True
                        break

            if not too_close:
                selected.append(art)

        # If diversity constraint left fewer than max_frames, fill with remaining highest scored
        if len(selected) < max_frames:
            selected_ids = {a.artifact_id for a in selected}
            for _, art in scored_candidates:
                if len(selected) >= max_frames:
                    break
                if art.artifact_id not in selected_ids:
                    selected.append(art)
                    selected_ids.add(art.artifact_id)

        logger.info(
            "VisualEvidenceAnnotator: selected %d incident frame(s) for investigation %s",
            len(selected),
            investigation_id,
        )
        return selected[:max_frames]

    def _get_cache_key(self, artifact: Artifact) -> str:
        ident = artifact.sha256 or artifact.artifact_id
        model_name = getattr(self.llm, "model_name", "vlm") if self.llm else "vlm"
        return f"{ident}:{model_name}:{ANNOTATION_CACHE_VERSION}"

    def draw_bounding_boxes(
        self,
        source_image_path: Path,
        output_image_path: Path,
        boxes: list[BoundingBox],
    ) -> bool:
        """Draw bounding boxes and concise labels on a copy of the source image.

        Never modifies or overwrites the source image.
        """
        if not source_image_path.is_file():
            return False

        valid_boxes = [b for b in boxes if b.valid]
        if not valid_boxes:
            return False

        try:
            with Image.open(source_image_path) as src_img:
                img = src_img.convert("RGB")

            width, height = img.size
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

            # Palette for distinct entity categories
            palette = {
                "person": "#38bdf8",   # Sky blue
                "vehicle": "#fbbf24",  # Amber
                "object": "#34d399",   # Emerald green
                "unknown": "#f87171",  # Red
            }

            for box in valid_boxes:
                color = palette.get(box.category.lower(), "#38bdf8")

                px_min = max(0, min(width - 1, int(box.x_min * width)))
                py_min = max(0, min(height - 1, int(box.y_min * height)))
                px_max = max(0, min(width, int(box.x_max * width)))
                py_max = max(0, min(height, int(box.y_max * height)))

                # Draw outer bounding rectangle
                draw.rectangle([px_min, py_min, px_max, py_max], outline=color, width=3)

                # Draw concise label badge
                conf_str = f" {box.confidence:.0%}" if box.confidence else ""
                label_text = f"{box.label}{conf_str}"

                # Calculate badge bounding box
                font = ImageFont.load_default()
                text_bbox = draw.textbbox((px_min + 3, py_min - 16), label_text, font=font)
                badge_bg = [
                    max(0, text_bbox[0] - 2),
                    max(0, text_bbox[1] - 2),
                    min(width, text_bbox[2] + 4),
                    min(height, text_bbox[3] + 2),
                ]
                draw.rectangle(badge_bg, fill="#0f172a")
                draw.text((badge_bg[0] + 3, badge_bg[1] + 1), label_text, fill=color, font=font)

            output_image_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            img.save(str(output_image_path), format="JPEG", quality=90)
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("VisualEvidenceAnnotator: Failed to render bounding boxes: %s", exc)
            return False

    def annotate_frame(
        self,
        artifact: Artifact,
        investigation_id: str,
        investigation_entities: list[Entity],
    ) -> VisualEvidenceItem:
        """Analyze a selected frame, extract tags and bounding boxes, and generate a report derivative."""
        cache_key = self._get_cache_key(artifact)
        cached = self._memory_cache.get(cache_key)

        caption = "Salient visual evidence recorded for incident timeline."
        tags: list[str] = ["incident_evidence", "visual_frame"]
        raw_detections: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        local_path = _uri_to_local_path(artifact.storage_uri)

        if cached:
            caption = cached.get("caption", caption)
            tags = cached.get("tags", tags)
            raw_detections = cached.get("detections", [])
        elif self.llm is not None and local_path is not None and local_path.is_file():
            prompt = (
                "Forensic object localization and tagging. "
                "Detect key entities (person, vehicle, object) visible in this frame relevant to an investigation. "
                "Output valid JSON in this exact structure: "
                "{"
                '  "caption": "Concise scene description", '
                '  "tags": ["tag1", "tag2"], '
                '  "detections": ['
                "    {"
                '      "category": "person | vehicle | object", '
                '      "label": "Suspect-1 | Vehicle-1", '
                '      "box_2d": [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], '
                '      "attributes": {"color": "...", "clothing_upper": "..."}, '
                '      "confidence": 0.95'
                "    }"
                "  ]"
                "} "
                "Normalized coordinates must be floats between 0.0 and 1.0 in [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] order."
            )
            try:
                response = self.llm.analyze_image(
                    prompt=prompt,
                    image_data=artifact.storage_uri,
                    mime_type="image/jpeg",
                    json_mode=True,
                )
                if response and response.content:
                    cleaned = clean_vlm_text(response.content)
                    parsed = json.loads(cleaned)
                    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                        caption = str(parsed.get("caption") or caption)
                        raw_tags = parsed.get("tags", [])
                        if isinstance(raw_tags, list):
                            tags = [str(t).strip() for t in raw_tags if str(t).strip()]
                        raw_detections = parsed.get("detections", [])
                        if not isinstance(raw_detections, list):
                            raw_detections = []

                # Cache valid raw output
                self._memory_cache[cache_key] = {
                    "caption": caption,
                    "tags": tags,
                    "detections": raw_detections,
                }
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning(
                    "VisualEvidenceAnnotator: VLM localization failed for artifact %s: %s; using unannotated evidence fallback.",
                    artifact.artifact_id,
                    exc,
                )

        # Normalize visual caption
        caption = normalize_observation_description(caption)

        # Build and validate BoundingBox models
        validated_boxes: list[BoundingBox] = []
        resolved_entity_ids: list[str] = []

        # Find existing observations linked to this frame artifact
        art_obs = [
            o for o in self.repository.list_observations()
            if artifact.artifact_id in o.artifact_ids
        ]
        art_obs_ids = {o.observation_id for o in art_obs}

        # Retrieve investigation entities previously resolved for this frame's observations
        frame_entities: list[Entity] = [
            ent for ent in investigation_entities
            if any(oid in art_obs_ids for oid in ent.associated_observation_ids)
        ]
        for fe in frame_entities:
            if fe.entity_id not in resolved_entity_ids:
                resolved_entity_ids.append(fe.entity_id)

        # Index known investigation entities by label for resolution linking
        entity_by_label: dict[str, Entity] = {}
        for ent in investigation_entities:
            if ent.label:
                entity_by_label[ent.label.strip().lower()] = ent

        for det in raw_detections:
            if not isinstance(det, dict):
                continue

            raw_box = det.get("box_2d", det.get("bbox", det.get("bounding_box")))
            valid_coords = validate_coordinates(raw_box)
            if not valid_coords:
                continue

            label = str(det.get("label", "Object")).strip() or "Object"
            category = str(det.get("category", "object")).strip().lower()
            confidence = det.get("confidence")
            if isinstance(confidence, (int, float)):
                confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(confidence)))
            else:
                confidence = None

            # Attempt entity resolution linking:
            # 1. Match against entities already established for this frame
            matched_ent_id: str | None = None
            for fe in frame_entities:
                if fe.label and fe.label.strip().lower() == label.lower():
                    matched_ent_id = fe.entity_id
                    break
                if fe.entity_type == category:
                    matched_ent_id = fe.entity_id
                    break

            # 2. Match against investigation-wide entities by specific label
            if not matched_ent_id and label.lower() in entity_by_label:
                matched_ent_id = entity_by_label[label.lower()].entity_id

            # 3. Create or resolve candidate entity if valid category provided
            raw_attr = det.get("attributes", {})
            attr = dict(raw_attr) if isinstance(raw_attr, dict) else {}

            if not matched_ent_id and category in {"person", "vehicle", "animal", "object"}:
                obs_ref = art_obs[0].observation_id if art_obs else f"obs-vis-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
                active_dict = {e.entity_id: e for e in investigation_entities}
                new_ent = resolve_or_create_entity(
                    repository=self.repository,
                    entity_info={
                        "entity_type": category,
                        "label": label,
                        "attributes": attr,
                    },
                    obs_id=obs_ref,
                    active_entities=active_dict,
                )
                matched_ent_id = new_ent.entity_id

            if matched_ent_id and matched_ent_id not in resolved_entity_ids:
                resolved_entity_ids.append(matched_ent_id)

            bbox = BoundingBox(
                x_min=valid_coords[0],
                y_min=valid_coords[1],
                x_max=valid_coords[2],
                y_max=valid_coords[3],
                label=label,
                category=category,
                confidence=confidence,
                entity_id=matched_ent_id,
                attributes=attr,
                valid=True,
            )
            validated_boxes.append(bbox)

        # Enrich tags with verified frame entity types
        for fe in frame_entities:
            if fe.entity_type and fe.entity_type not in tags:
                tags.append(fe.entity_type)

        # Draw derivative annotated image if local file exists and boxes are valid
        annotated_art_id: str | None = None
        has_overlay = False
        display_uri = artifact.storage_uri

        if local_path and local_path.is_file() and validated_boxes:
            annotated_dir = self.storage_dir / "annotated_evidence" / investigation_id
            annotated_filename = f"{artifact.artifact_id}_annotated.jpg"
            annotated_path = annotated_dir / annotated_filename

            drawn = self.draw_bounding_boxes(
                source_image_path=local_path,
                output_image_path=annotated_path,
                boxes=validated_boxes,
            )

            if drawn and annotated_path.is_file():
                has_overlay = True
                display_uri = annotated_path.as_uri()
                annotated_art_id = f"art-ann-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
                derivative_art = Artifact(
                    artifact_id=annotated_art_id,
                    artifact_type="derived_media",
                    media_type="image",
                    storage_uri=display_uri,
                    source_reference=artifact.source_reference,
                    sha256=generate_sha256(annotated_path.read_bytes()),
                )
                self.repository.add_artifact(derivative_art)

        # Extract camera and timeline context
        sr = artifact.source_reference
        media_id = sr.media_asset_id if sr else None
        timestamp_s = sr.start_seconds if sr else None

        camera_id = None
        camera_label = None
        if media_id:
            try:
                media_asset = self.repository.get_media_asset(media_id)
                camera_id = media_asset.camera_id
                if camera_id:
                    cam = self.repository.get_camera(camera_id)
                    camera_label = cam.location_label or cam.name
            except Exception:
                pass

        return VisualEvidenceItem(
            artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
            annotated_artifact_id=annotated_art_id,
            storage_uri=display_uri,
            original_storage_uri=artifact.storage_uri,
            media_asset_id=media_id,
            camera_id=camera_id,
            camera_label=camera_label,
            timestamp_seconds=timestamp_s,
            caption=caption,
            tags=tags,
            resolved_entity_ids=resolved_entity_ids,
            bounding_boxes=validated_boxes,
            has_overlay=has_overlay,
        )

    def prepare_visual_evidence(
        self,
        investigation_id: str,
        max_frames: int = 3,
    ) -> list[VisualEvidenceItem]:
        """High-level pipeline: Select up to max_frames incident frames and annotate them."""
        selected_artifacts = self.select_incident_frames(
            investigation_id=investigation_id,
            max_frames=max_frames,
        )
        if not selected_artifacts:
            return []

        all_entities = self.repository.list_entities()
        items: list[VisualEvidenceItem] = []
        for art in selected_artifacts:
            item = self.annotate_frame(
                artifact=art,
                investigation_id=investigation_id,
                investigation_entities=all_entities,
            )
            items.append(item)

        return items

"""Visual detection tool worker analyzing image artifacts for persons, vehicles, and objects."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import math
import re
import uuid
from typing import Any

from vigil.domain.entity import Entity
from vigil.domain.observation import Observation
from vigil.domain.provenance import Provenance
from vigil.orchestration.task_types import TaskRequest
from vigil.tools.base import BaseToolWorker

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def clean_vlm_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Clean markdown formatting or raw code fence artifacts from descriptions."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    cleaned = text.strip()
    if "```" in cleaned:
        fence_match = re.search(r"```(?:json|markdown)?\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```", cleaned)
        if fence_match:
            return fence_match.group(1).strip()
        if cleaned.startswith("```json"):
            cleaned = cleaned[len("```json"):].strip()
        elif cleaned.startswith("```"):
            cleaned = cleaned[len("```"):].strip()
        if cleaned.endswith("```"):
            cleaned = cleaned[:-3].strip()
    return cleaned


def normalize_observation_description(text: str) -> str:
    """Normalize raw model outputs into a clean, concise, grammatical forensic description.

    Idempotent: An already-clean human-readable description remains completely unchanged.
    Removes raw JSON wrappers, markdown code fences, unescaped characters, and model boilerplate.
    Preserves camera context prefix, timestamps, and verifiable evidence.
    """
    if not text or not str(text).strip():
        return ""
    cleaned = str(text).strip()

    # Extract camera context prefix if present, e.g. "[cam-north: North Gate] "
    cam_prefix = ""
    cam_match = re.match(r"^(\[[^\]]+\])\s*", cleaned)
    if cam_match:
        cam_prefix = cam_match.group(1) + " "
        cleaned = cleaned[cam_match.end():].strip()

    # Unwrap markdown fences
    if "```" in cleaned:
        cleaned = clean_vlm_text(cleaned)

    # If the text is JSON or contains JSON structure, parse it
    if (cleaned.startswith("{") and cleaned.endswith("}")) or (cleaned.startswith("[") and cleaned.endswith("]")) or ("{" in cleaned and "}" in cleaned):
        try:
            json_str = cleaned
            if not (cleaned.startswith("{") or cleaned.startswith("[")):
                start_obj = cleaned.find("{")
                start_arr = cleaned.find("[")
                start_candidates = [idx for idx in (start_obj, start_arr) if idx != -1]
                if start_candidates:
                    start_idx = min(start_candidates)
                    end_idx = max(cleaned.rfind("}"), cleaned.rfind("]"))
                    if end_idx > start_idx:
                        json_str = cleaned[start_idx : end_idx + 1]

            parsed = json.loads(json_str)
            if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                if parsed.get("description"):
                    cleaned = str(parsed["description"])
                elif parsed.get("observations") and isinstance(parsed["observations"], list):
                    items = []
                    for itm in parsed["observations"]:
                        if isinstance(itm, dict):
                            desc_part = itm.get("description") or itm.get("finding") or itm.get("label")
                            if desc_part:
                                items.append(str(desc_part).strip())
                        elif isinstance(itm, str):
                            items.append(itm.strip())
                    if items:
                        cleaned = " ".join(items)
                elif parsed.get("scene") or parsed.get("summary"):
                    cleaned = str(parsed.get("scene") or parsed.get("summary"))
                elif parsed.get("label") or parsed.get("finding"):
                    cleaned = str(parsed.get("label") or parsed.get("finding"))
                else:
                    parts = [f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in parsed.items() if v and isinstance(v, (str, int, float))]
                    if parts:
                        cleaned = "; ".join(parts)
            elif isinstance(parsed, list):
                items = []
                for itm in parsed:
                    if isinstance(itm, dict):
                        d = itm.get("description") or itm.get("label")
                        if d:
                            items.append(str(d).strip())
                    elif isinstance(itm, str):
                        items.append(itm.strip())
                if items:
                    cleaned = " ".join(items)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Clean escaped characters
    cleaned = cleaned.replace('\\"', '"').replace('\\n', ' ').replace('\\r', '')

    # Remove AI / VLM boilerplate phrases (case-insensitive)
    boilerplate_patterns = [
        r"^(?:based on (?:the )?(?:visual|image|frame|surveillance|provided)[^,:\.\n]*[,:\.\n]\s*)",
        r"^(?:in this (?:surveillance )?(?:frame|image|scene|video)[^,:\.\n]*[,:\.\n]\s*)",
        r"^(?:the (?:provided )?(?:surveillance )?(?:video )?(?:footage|image|frame|scene) (?:shows|depicts|displays|reveals|contains)\s*)",
        r"^(?:here is the (?:visual |forensic )?analysis[^,:\.\n]*[,:\.\n]\s*)",
        r"^(?:we can observe that\s*)",
        r"^(?:it appears that\s*)",
    ]
    for pat in boilerplate_patterns:
        cleaned = re.sub(pat, "", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()

    # Clean redundant JSON / syntax remnants
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[\{\}\[\]]", "", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^\s*["\']\s*', "", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'\s*["\']\s*$', "", cleaned)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cleaned).strip()

    # Capitalize the first character
    if cleaned:
        cleaned = cleaned[0].upper() + cleaned[1:]

    # Fallback if text is empty or meaningless
    if not cleaned or len(cleaned) < 3 or set(cleaned).issubset(set(".,;:-_ '\"")):
        cleaned = "Visual features observed in frame."

    return f"{cam_prefix}{cleaned}"


def parse_vlm_detection_response(raw_content: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Parse VLM output into structured observation items and candidate entity descriptors.

    Robustly handles markdown fences, embedded JSON, top-level entities, and free-text narratives.
    """
    if not raw_content or not raw_content.strip():
        return [], []

    cleaned = clean_vlm_text(raw_content)
    parsed: Any = None

    try:
        parsed = json.loads(cleaned)
    except Exception:
        start_obj = cleaned.find("{")
        start_arr = cleaned.find("[")
        start_candidates = [idx for idx in (start_obj, start_arr) if idx != -1]
        if start_candidates:
            start_idx = min(start_candidates)
            end_idx = max(cleaned.rfind("}"), cleaned.rfind("]"))
            if end_idx > start_idx:
                try:
                    parsed = json.loads(cleaned[start_idx : end_idx + 1])
                except Exception:
                    parsed = None

    observations_data: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    entities_data: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
        if "observations" in parsed:
            raw_obs = parsed["observations"]
            if isinstance(raw_obs, list):
                observations_data = [item for item in raw_obs if isinstance(item, dict)]
            elif isinstance(raw_obs, dict):
                observations_data = [raw_obs]
        elif "findings" in parsed and isinstance(parsed["findings"], list):
            observations_data = [item for item in parsed["findings"] if isinstance(item, dict)]
        elif "detections" in parsed and isinstance(parsed["detections"], list):
            observations_data = [item for item in parsed["detections"] if isinstance(item, dict)]
        elif "description" in parsed:
            observations_data = [parsed]

        top_entities = parsed.get("entities")
        if isinstance(top_entities, list):
            for e in top_entities:
                if isinstance(e, dict):
                    entities_data.append(e)
                elif isinstance(e, str) and e.strip():
                    entities_data.append({"label": e.strip(), "entity_type": "object"})
        elif isinstance(parsed.get("entity"), (dict, str)):
            e = parsed["entity"]
            entities_data.append(e if isinstance(e, dict) else {"label": str(e), "entity_type": "object"})

    elif isinstance(parsed, list):
        observations_data = [item for item in parsed if isinstance(item, dict)]

    for obs_item in observations_data:
        ent = obs_item.get("entity")
        if ent and isinstance(ent, (dict, str)):
            entities_data.append(ent if isinstance(ent, dict) else {"label": str(ent), "entity_type": "object"})
        ents = obs_item.get("entities")
        if isinstance(ents, list):
            for e in ents:
                if isinstance(e, (dict, str)):
                    entities_data.append(e if isinstance(e, dict) else {"label": str(e), "entity_type": "object"})

    if not observations_data and raw_content.strip():
        norm_desc = normalize_observation_description(raw_content)
        observations_data = [
            {
                "observation_type": "visual_detection",
                "description": norm_desc,
                "confidence": 0.85,
            }
        ]
        lower_desc = norm_desc.lower()
        if any(w in lower_desc for w in ("person", "man", "woman", "individual", "pedestrian", "suspect")):
            entities_data.append({
                "entity_type": "person",
                "label": "Person-1",
                "attributes": {"detection_source": "visual_narrative"},
            })
        if any(w in lower_desc for w in ("car", "vehicle", "sedan", "truck", "suv", "van", "motorcycle")):
            entities_data.append({
                "entity_type": "vehicle",
                "label": "Vehicle-1",
                "attributes": {"detection_source": "visual_narrative"},
            })
        if any(w in lower_desc for w in ("dog", "cat", "animal", "bird")):
            entities_data.append({
                "entity_type": "animal",
                "label": "Animal-1",
                "attributes": {"detection_source": "visual_narrative"},
            })

    return observations_data, entities_data


_GENERIC_ENTITY_LABELS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "person",
    "vehicle",
    "animal",
    "object",
    "unknown",
    "subject",
    "car",
    "man",
    "woman",
    "individual",
    "pedestrian",
})


def _is_specific_label(label: str | None, entity_type: str) -> bool:
    """Determine whether an entity label is informative rather than a generic placeholder."""
    if not label:
        return False
    cleaned = label.strip()
    if not cleaned or cleaned.lower() in _GENERIC_ENTITY_LABELS:
        return False
    # Auto-generated prefix patterns like person_ent-123 or ent-abc
    if cleaned.startswith(f"{entity_type}_ent-") or cleaned.startswith("ent-"):
        return False
    return True


def resolve_or_create_entity(
    repository: Any,
    entity_info: dict[str, Any] | str,
    obs_id: str,
    active_entities: dict[str, Entity],
) -> Entity:
    """Conservatively resolve or create an entity record within an investigation.

    Rules:
    1. Reuse verified explicit entity references if supplied.
    2. Match against active scoped entities by matching entity_type and specific label,
       or strong non-conflicting multi-attribute overlap.
    3. Do NOT merge based solely on generic labels or single clothing color.
    4. Preserve unresolved entities when uncertain.
    5. Safely merge attributes and update associated_observation_ids without duplicates.
    """
    if isinstance(entity_info, str):
        raw_str = entity_info.strip()
        lower_str = raw_str.lower()
        if any(w in lower_str for w in ("car", "vehicle", "truck", "sedan", "van", "motorcycle", "bike")):
            e_type = "vehicle"
        elif any(w in lower_str for w in ("person", "man", "woman", "individual", "pedestrian", "suspect")):
            e_type = "person"
        elif any(w in lower_str for w in ("dog", "cat", "animal", "bird")):
            e_type = "animal"
        else:
            e_type = "object"
        entity_info = {"entity_type": e_type, "label": raw_str, "attributes": {"description": raw_str}}

    raw_type = str(
        entity_info.get("entity_type")
        or entity_info.get("category")
        or entity_info.get("type")
        or "person"
    ).strip().lower()
    # Normalize common synonyms
    if raw_type in {"human", "pedestrian", "man", "woman", "suspect", "individual"}:
        raw_type = "person"
    elif raw_type in {"car", "truck", "motorcycle", "automobile", "bus", "van", "sedan"}:
        raw_type = "vehicle"

    valid_types = {"person", "vehicle", "animal", "object", "unknown"}
    entity_type = raw_type if raw_type in valid_types else "unknown"

    raw_attributes = entity_info.get("attributes", {})
    attributes: dict[str, Any] = (
        dict(raw_attributes) if isinstance(raw_attributes, dict) else {}
    )
    # Sanitize attributes according to Entity schema (non-blank keys, finite values, stringified nested data)
    clean_attributes: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for k, v in attributes.items():
        if isinstance(k, str) and k.strip():
            if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                v = json.dumps(v)
            elif isinstance(v, float) and not math.isfinite(v):
                continue
            clean_attributes[k.strip()] = v

    candidate_label = str(entity_info.get("label", "")).strip() or None
    is_cand_specific = _is_specific_label(candidate_label, entity_type)

    matched_entity: Entity | None = None

    # 1. Explicit verified reference
    explicit_id = entity_info.get("entity_id")
    if explicit_id and str(explicit_id) in active_entities:
        existing = active_entities[str(explicit_id)]
        if existing.entity_type == entity_type:
            matched_entity = existing

    # 2. Heuristic resolution if not explicitly resolved
    if matched_entity is None:
        for existing in active_entities.values():
            if existing.entity_type != entity_type:
                continue

            # Check for hard attribute conflicts
            has_conflict = False
            matching_attr_count = 0
            for k, v in clean_attributes.items():
                if k in existing.attributes:
                    ev = existing.attributes[k]
                    if v is not None and ev is not None:
                        str_v = str(v).strip().lower()
                        str_ev = str(ev).strip().lower()
                        if str_v != str_ev:
                            has_conflict = True
                            break
                        matching_attr_count += 1

            if has_conflict:
                continue

            # Case A: Same specific label (e.g. Suspect-1, Vehicle-1) without conflict
            is_exist_specific = _is_specific_label(existing.label, entity_type)
            if (
                is_cand_specific
                and is_exist_specific
                and candidate_label is not None
                and existing.label is not None
                and candidate_label.strip().lower() == existing.label.strip().lower()
            ):
                matched_entity = existing
                break

            # Case B: Multi-attribute match (at least 2 distinctive matching attributes)
            if matching_attr_count >= 2:
                matched_entity = existing
                break

            # Case C: Distinctive single attribute such as license_plate or id_badge
            for distinctive_key in ("license_plate", "plate", "id_badge", "badge_number"):
                if (
                    distinctive_key in clean_attributes
                    and clean_attributes[distinctive_key]
                    and distinctive_key in existing.attributes
                    and str(clean_attributes[distinctive_key]).strip().lower()
                    == str(existing.attributes[distinctive_key]).strip().lower()
                ):
                    matched_entity = existing
                    break
            if matched_entity is not None:
                break

    # 3. Update existing or create new
    if matched_entity is not None:
        # Avoid duplicate observation IDs
        new_obs_ids = list(matched_entity.associated_observation_ids)
        if obs_id not in new_obs_ids:
            new_obs_ids.append(obs_id)

        # Merge attributes without losing existing attributes
        merged_attributes = dict(matched_entity.attributes)
        for k, v in clean_attributes.items():
            if k not in merged_attributes or merged_attributes[k] in (None, ""):
                merged_attributes[k] = v

        # Update label if existing was generic and candidate is specific
        new_label = matched_entity.label
        if (
            not _is_specific_label(matched_entity.label, entity_type)
            and is_cand_specific
            and candidate_label is not None
        ):
            new_label = candidate_label

        updated_entity = Entity(
            entity_id=matched_entity.entity_id,
            entity_type=matched_entity.entity_type,
            label=new_label,
            attributes=merged_attributes,
            associated_observation_ids=new_obs_ids,
        )
        repository.add_entity(updated_entity)
        active_entities[updated_entity.entity_id] = updated_entity
        return updated_entity

    # Create new entity record
    new_ent_id = f"ent-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    default_label = candidate_label or f"{entity_type}_{new_ent_id[:6]}"
    new_entity = Entity(
        entity_id=new_ent_id,
        entity_type=entity_type,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        label=default_label,
        attributes=clean_attributes,
        associated_observation_ids=[obs_id],
    )
    repository.add_entity(new_entity)
    active_entities[new_entity.entity_id] = new_entity
    return new_entity


class VisualDetectorWorker(BaseToolWorker):
    """Analyzes image/frame artifacts using vision models to produce Observations and Entities."""

    def run(self, request: TaskRequest) -> list[str]:
        artifact_ids = list(request.input_refs)
        investigation_id = request.parameters.get("investigation_id")

        if not artifact_ids and investigation_id:
            try:
                inv = self.repository.get_investigation(str(investigation_id))
                target_media = set(inv.media_asset_ids)
                all_arts = self.repository.list_artifacts()
                scoped_arts = [
                    a for a in all_arts
                    if a.media_type == "image"
                    and a.source_reference
                    and a.source_reference.media_asset_id in target_media
                ]
                if scoped_arts:
                    artifact_ids = [a.artifact_id for a in scoped_arts]
            except Exception:
                pass

        if not artifact_ids:
            # Look up available image artifacts in repository
            all_artifacts = self.repository.list_artifacts()
            image_artifacts = [a for a in all_artifacts if a.media_type == "image"]
            if not image_artifacts:
                raise ValueError("No image artifacts found for visual detection.")
            artifact_ids = [a.artifact_id for a in image_artifacts]

        # Balance sampling across multiple media assets / cameras
        media_groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for aid in artifact_ids:
            try:
                art = self.repository.get_artifact(aid)
                mid = (
                    art.source_reference.media_asset_id
                    if art.source_reference
                    else "default"
                )
                media_groups.setdefault(mid, []).append(aid)
            except Exception:
                media_groups.setdefault("default", []).append(aid)

        max_frames_per_task = int(request.parameters.get("max_frames_per_task", 8))
        if len(media_groups) > 1:
            per_media_limit = max(2, max_frames_per_task // len(media_groups))
            balanced_ids: list[str] = []
            for m_aids in media_groups.values():
                balanced_ids.extend(m_aids[:per_media_limit])
            artifact_ids = balanced_ids
        else:
            artifact_ids = artifact_ids[:max_frames_per_task]

        logger.info(
            "VisualDetectorWorker: analyzing %d frame(s) across %d media feed(s) for task %s",
            len(artifact_ids),
            len(media_groups),
            request.task_id,
        )

        # Retrieve objective context
        obj_context = ""
        if investigation_id:
            try:
                inv = self.repository.get_investigation(str(investigation_id))
                if inv.objective:
                    obj_context = f"Investigation Objective: '{inv.objective}'. Focus on identifying details directly answering this query.\n"
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Lookup tables for camera and media metadata
        media_map = {m.media_asset_id: m for m in self.repository.list_media_assets()}
        camera_map = {c.camera_id: c for c in self.repository.list_cameras()}

        # Collect existing entities scoped to this investigation for conservative resolution
        scoped_obs_ids: set[str] = set()
        if investigation_id:
            try:
                state = self.repository.get_state(str(investigation_id))
                if state is not None:
                    scoped_obs_ids.update(state.observation_ids)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if not scoped_obs_ids:
                try:
                    inv = self.repository.get_investigation(str(investigation_id))
                    target_media = set(inv.media_asset_ids)
                    for o in self.repository.list_observations():
                        if any(
                            sr.media_asset_id in target_media
                            for sr in o.source_references
                        ):
                            scoped_obs_ids.add(o.observation_id)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        all_entities = self.repository.list_entities()
        active_entities: dict[str, Entity] = {}
        for ent in all_entities:
            if not scoped_obs_ids or any(
                oid in scoped_obs_ids for oid in ent.associated_observation_ids
            ):
                active_entities[ent.entity_id] = ent

        output_observation_ids: list[str] = []

        for art_id in artifact_ids:
            artifact = self.repository.get_artifact(art_id)

            # Camera context for this frame
            cam_label = ""
            if (
                artifact.source_reference
                and artifact.source_reference.media_asset_id in media_map
            ):
                asset = media_map[artifact.source_reference.media_asset_id]
                if asset.camera_id and asset.camera_id in camera_map:
                    cam = camera_map[asset.camera_id]
                    cam_label = (
                        f"[{cam.camera_id}: {cam.location_label or cam.name}]"
                    )
                elif asset.camera_id:
                    cam_label = f"[{asset.camera_id}]"

            # ------------------------------------------------------------------
            # Validate the artifact storage URI before dispatching to the VLM.
            # Synthetic / mock URIs (e.g. file:///storage/artifacts/…) that do
            # not resolve to a real file on disk cannot be base64-encoded and
            # would cause the API call to fail. Skip them with a fallback
            # observation so the rest of the queue is unaffected.
            # ------------------------------------------------------------------
            uri = artifact.storage_uri
            _is_resolvable = False
            if uri.startswith("http://") or uri.startswith("https://"):
                _is_resolvable = True
            else:
                from pathlib import Path as _Path
                from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse as _urlparse
                try:
                    if uri.startswith("file://"):
                        _parsed = _urlparse(uri)
                        _pstr = unquote(_parsed.path)
                        if _pstr.startswith("/") and len(_pstr) > 2 and _pstr[2] == ":":
                            _pstr = _pstr[1:]
                        _is_resolvable = _Path(_pstr).is_file()
                    else:
                        _is_resolvable = _Path(uri).is_file()
                except Exception:
                    _is_resolvable = False

            if not _is_resolvable:
                logger.warning(
                    "VisualDetectorWorker: artifact %s has unresolvable storage URI '%s'; "
                    "skipping VLM call and recording placeholder observation.",
                    art_id,
                    uri,
                )
                raw_content = ""
            else:
                cam_feed_str = f"Camera feed: {cam_label}. " if cam_label else ""
                prompt = (
                    f"Forensic visual analysis. {cam_feed_str}{obj_context}"
                    "Identify all persons, vehicles, objects, and activities visible in this frame. "
                    "Output JSON with a list of 'observations', each having: "
                    "'observation_type', 'description', 'confidence', and optional 'entity' with "
                    "'entity_type' (person/vehicle/animal/object/unknown), 'label', and 'attributes'."
                )

                try:
                    response = self.llm.analyze_image(
                        prompt=prompt,
                        image_data=uri,
                        mime_type="image/jpeg",
                        json_mode=True,
                    )
                    raw_content = response.content
                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                    logger.warning(
                        "VisualDetectorWorker: frame %s VLM call failed (%s); "
                        "recording fallback observation — other frames will continue.",
                        art_id,
                        exc,
                    )
                    raw_content = ""

            # Parse findings and candidate entities
            observations_data, frame_entities = parse_vlm_detection_response(raw_content)

            if not observations_data:
                observations_data = [
                    {
                        "observation_type": "scene_inspection",
                        "description": "Visual inspection completed without salient detections.",
                        "confidence": 0.80,
                    }
                ]

            for obs_item in observations_data:
                obs_id = f"obs-vis-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
                obs_type = str(obs_item.get("observation_type", "visual_detection"))
                raw_desc = str(obs_item.get("description", "Salient visual detection."))
                clean_desc = normalize_observation_description(raw_desc)
                # Prepend camera context if not already present
                if cam_label and cam_label not in clean_desc:
                    desc = f"{cam_label} {clean_desc}"
                else:
                    desc = clean_desc

                confidence = float(obs_item.get("confidence", 0.90))
                confidence = min(max(confidence, 0.0), 1.0)

                provenance = Provenance(
                    producer_type="vision_model",
                    producer_name=getattr(self.llm, "model_name", "vision_model")
                    or "vision_model",
                    method="visual_detection",
                    input_artifact_ids=[artifact.artifact_id],
                )

                obs = Observation(
                    observation_id=obs_id,
                    modality="image",
                    observation_type=obs_type,
                    description=desc,
                    source_references=[artifact.source_reference],
                    artifact_ids=[artifact.artifact_id],
                    confidence=confidence,
                    provenance=provenance,
                )

                self.repository.add_observation(obs)
                output_observation_ids.append(obs_id)

                # Process all candidate entities linked to this observation and frame
                item_entities: list[dict[str, Any] | str] = []
                if obs_item.get("entity"):
                    item_entities.append(obs_item["entity"])
                if isinstance(obs_item.get("entities"), list):
                    item_entities.extend(obs_item["entities"])
                item_entities.extend(frame_entities)

                for ent_info in item_entities:
                    if isinstance(ent_info, (dict, str)):
                        resolve_or_create_entity(
                            repository=self.repository,
                            entity_info=ent_info,
                            obs_id=obs_id,
                            active_entities=active_entities,
                        )

        return output_observation_ids
