from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from tests.media_test_helpers import create_test_video
from vigil.media.decoder import MediaDecoder


def test_extract_frames_from_video(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    video_path = tmp_path / "test_extract.mp4"
    create_test_video(video_path, duration_seconds=2.0, fps=24, width=320, height=240)

    out_frames_dir = tmp_path / "frames"
    frames = MediaDecoder.extract_frames(
        file_path=video_path,
        output_dir=out_frames_dir,
        sample_interval_seconds=0.5,
        max_frames=5,
    )

    assert len(frames) > 0
    assert len(frames) <= 5

    for f in frames:
        assert Path(f.file_path).is_file()
        assert f.width == 320
        assert f.height == 240
        assert len(f.sha256) == 64
        assert f.timestamp_seconds >= 0.0


def test_demux_audio_to_wav(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    video_path = tmp_path / "test_demux.mp4"
    create_test_video(video_path, duration_seconds=1.5, with_audio=True)

    wav_out = tmp_path / "audio" / "extracted.wav"
    demuxed = MediaDecoder.demux_audio_to_wav(
        file_path=video_path,
        output_path=wav_out,
        target_sample_rate=16000,
    )

    assert Path(demuxed.file_path).is_file()
    assert demuxed.sample_rate == 16000
    assert demuxed.channels in {1, 2}
    assert demuxed.duration_seconds > 0.0
    assert len(demuxed.sha256) == 64

    create_test_video(silent_video, duration_seconds=1.0, with_audio=False)

"""Unit tests for MediaIngestionService."""

from pathlib import Path

from tests.media_test_helpers import create_test_video
from vigil.media.ingestion import MediaIngestionService
from vigil.storage.repository import InvestigationRepository


def test_media_ingestion_service_e2e(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    service = MediaIngestionService(repository=repo)

    video_path = tmp_path / "camera_feed.mp4"
    create_test_video(video_path, duration_seconds=2.0, fps=24, with_audio=True)

    result = service.ingest_file(
        file_path=video_path,
        media_asset_id="media-cctv-1",
        camera_id="cam-gate-north",
        camera_name="North Gate Camera",
        output_artifacts_dir=tmp_path / "artifacts",
        sample_interval_seconds=0.5,
        max_frames=4,
        extract_audio=True,
    )

    # 1. Verify MediaAsset was stored in repository
    asset = repo.get_media_asset("media-cctv-1")
    assert asset.camera_id == "cam-gate-north"
    assert asset.media_type == "video"
    assert asset.duration_seconds is not None
    assert asset.duration_seconds > 0
    assert len(asset.sha256 or "") == 64

    # 2. Verify Camera was stored in repository
    camera = repo.get_camera("cam-gate-north")
    assert camera.name == "North Gate Camera"

    # 3. Verify Artifacts in repository
    assert len(result.frame_artifacts) > 0
    for art in result.frame_artifacts:
        stored_art = repo.get_artifact(art.artifact_id)
        assert stored_art.artifact_type == "frame"
        assert stored_art.media_type == "image"
        assert Path(stored_art.storage_uri.replace("file:///", "")).is_file()

    assert len(result.audio_artifacts) > 0
    for a_art in result.audio_artifacts:
        stored_audio = repo.get_artifact(a_art.artifact_id)
        assert stored_audio.artifact_type == "audio_segment"
        assert stored_audio.media_type == "audio"

"""Unit tests for incident clip cutting tool."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from tests.media_test_helpers import create_test_video
from vigil.media.slicer import ClipSlicer


def test_slice_clip_valid_interval(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    src_video = tmp_path / "long_source.mp4"
    create_test_video(src_video, duration_seconds=3.0, fps=24, width=320, height=240, with_audio=True)

    out_clip = tmp_path / "clips" / "incident_01.mp4"
    result = ClipSlicer.slice_clip(
        source_path=src_video,
        output_path=out_clip,
        start_seconds=0.5,
        end_seconds=2.0,
        padding_seconds=0.0,
    )

    assert Path(result.clip_path).is_file()
    assert result.duration_seconds > 0.5
    assert result.start_seconds == 0.5
    assert result.end_seconds == 2.0
    assert len(result.sha256) == 64
    assert result.width == 320
    assert result.height == 240


def test_slice_clip_with_padding(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    src_video = tmp_path / "source.mp4"
    create_test_video(src_video, duration_seconds=3.0, fps=24)

    out_clip = tmp_path / "padded_clip.mp4"
    result = ClipSlicer.slice_clip(
        source_path=src_video,
        output_path=out_clip,
        start_seconds=1.0,
        end_seconds=2.0,
        padding_seconds=0.25,
    )

    assert Path(result.clip_path).is_file()
    assert result.start_seconds == 0.75
    assert result.end_seconds == 2.25
    assert result.duration_seconds > 0.0


def test_slice_clip_invalid_intervals_raise(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    src_video = tmp_path / "source.mp4"
    create_test_video(src_video, duration_seconds=2.0)

    out_clip = tmp_path / "bad.mp4"

    # end <= start
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ClipSlicer.slice_clip(src_video, out_clip, start_seconds=2.0, end_seconds=1.0)

    # start < 0
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ClipSlicer.slice_clip(src_video, out_clip, start_seconds=-1.0, end_seconds=1.0)


def test_slice_clip_missing_file_raises() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        ClipSlicer.slice_clip("missing.mp4", "out.mp4", start_seconds=0.0, end_seconds=1.0)

"""Unit tests for Llama 3.2 Vision image preprocessor and Greedy Knapsack batcher."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from vigil.models.nvidia_nim import NvidiaNIMClient
from vigil.models.vlm_preprocessor import (
    GreedyKnapsackBatcher,
    ImageBatch,
    Llama32VisionPreprocessor,
    PreprocessedImage,
)
from VLM_Accelerator.knapsack import calculate_http_limits
from VLM_Accelerator.preprocessor import Llama32VisionPreprocessor as StandalonePreprocessor


def create_test_image(width: int, height: int, color: tuple[int, int, int] = (100, 150, 200)) -> bytes:
    img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), color=color)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=90)
    return buf.getvalue()


class TestLlama32VisionPreprocessor:
    def test_find_best_grid(self) -> None:
        pre = Llama32VisionPreprocessor()
        # Square image -> (1, 1)
        assert pre.find_best_grid(1000, 1000) == (1, 1)
        # 16:9 wide image -> (2, 1) [1120x560]
        assert pre.find_best_grid(1920, 1080) == (2, 1)
        # Tall portrait image -> (1, 2) [560x1120]
        assert pre.find_best_grid(1080, 1920) == (1, 2)

    def test_calculate_target_resolution_compact(self) -> None:
        pre = Llama32VisionPreprocessor()
        # 1080p in compact mode must fit inside 560x560
        target_size, grid = pre.calculate_target_resolution(1920, 1080, mode="compact")
        assert grid == (1, 1)
        assert target_size[0] == 560
        assert target_size[1] == 315

    def test_calculate_target_resolution_optimal(self) -> None:
        pre = Llama32VisionPreprocessor()
        # 1080p in optimal mode matches (2, 1) grid -> fits inside 1120x560
        target_size, grid = pre.calculate_target_resolution(1920, 1080, mode="optimal")
        assert grid == (2, 1)
        assert target_size[0] <= 1120
        assert target_size[1] <= 560

    def test_preprocess_image_bytes_and_tokens(self) -> None:
        pre = Llama32VisionPreprocessor()
        raw_jpeg = create_test_image(1920, 1080)
        orig_len = len(raw_jpeg)

        res = pre.preprocess_image(raw_jpeg, mode="compact", identifier="test_frame")
        assert res.identifier == "test_frame"
        assert res.processed_size == (560, 315)
        assert res.num_tiles == 1
        assert res.estimated_tokens == 1604  # 1600 + 4
        assert res.byte_size < orig_len
        assert res.base64_data != ""
        assert res.data_uri.startswith("data:image/jpeg;base64,")


class TestGreedyKnapsackBatcher:
    def test_knapsack_packs_within_byte_limit(self) -> None:
        pre = Llama32VisionPreprocessor()
        batcher = GreedyKnapsackBatcher(
            max_payload_bytes=100_000,
            headroom_bytes=0,
            max_items_per_batch=4,
        )

        items: list[PreprocessedImage] = []
        for i in range(8):
            data = create_test_image(800, 600)
            p = pre.preprocess_image(data, mode="compact", identifier=f"frame_{i}")
            items.append(p)

        batches = batcher.allocate_batches(items, strategy="first_fit_decreasing")
        assert len(batches) > 1

        for b in batches:
            assert b.total_wire_bytes <= 100_000
            assert len(b.images) <= 4

    def test_build_nim_multimodal_message(self) -> None:
        pre = Llama32VisionPreprocessor()
        batcher = GreedyKnapsackBatcher()

        p1 = pre.preprocess_image(create_test_image(200, 200), identifier="f1", timestamp_seconds=1.5)
        p2 = pre.preprocess_image(create_test_image(200, 200), identifier="f2", timestamp_seconds=3.0)

        batch = ImageBatch(batch_index=0)
        batch.add(p1)
        batch.add(p2)

        messages = batcher.build_nim_multimodal_message(
            prompt="Detect suspects",
            batch=batch,
            system_instruction="Forensic assistant",
        )

        assert len(messages) == 2
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "system"
        assert messages[0]["content"] == "Forensic assistant"
        assert messages[1]["role"] == "user"

        content = messages[1]["content"]
        assert content[0]["type"] == "text"
        assert "f1 at 1.5s" in content[0]["text"]
        assert content[1]["type"] == "image_url"
        assert content[2]["type"] == "image_url"


class TestNvidiaNIMClientBatching:
    @patch.object(NvidiaNIMClient, "_call_completions")

        assert len(responses) >= 1

class TestStandaloneAccelerator:
    def test_calculate_http_limits(self) -> None:

PATH - tests\unit\orchestration\test_executor.py
CODE:
"""Tests for synchronous task execution."""

import pytest

from vigil.orchestration.executor import (
    TaskExecutor,
    TaskResultContractError,
    UnknownTaskTypeError,
)
from vigil.orchestration.task_types import (
    ErrorDetail,
    TaskRequest,
    TaskResult,
    TaskStatus,
)


def make_request(
    task_id: str = "task-001",
    task_type: str = "demo",
) -> TaskRequest:
    """Build a valid request for executor tests."""
    return TaskRequest(
        task_id=task_id,
        task_type=task_type,
        input_refs=[],
        parameters={},
    )


def make_result(
    task_id: str = "task-001",
    status: TaskStatus = TaskStatus.COMPLETED,
) -> TaskResult:
    """Build a valid result for executor tests."""
    error = (
        ErrorDetail(
            code="TEST_ERROR",
            message="Simulated task failure",
            retryable=False,
        )
        if status == TaskStatus.FAILED
        else None
    )

    return TaskResult(
        task_id=task_id,
        status=status,
        output_refs=[],
        error=error,
    )


class FakeWorker:
    """A deterministic worker used only in tests."""

    def __init__(self, result: object | None = None) -> None:
        self.result = result
        self.received_request: TaskRequest | None = None

    def execute(self, request: TaskRequest) -> TaskResult:
        self.received_request = request

        if self.result is None:
            return make_result(task_id=request.task_id)

        return self.result  # type: ignore[return-value]


def test_executor_routes_request_to_registered_worker() -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()
    worker = FakeWorker()
    executor.register("demo", worker)
    request = make_request()

    result = executor.execute(request)

    assert result.task_id == request.task_id
    assert result.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED
    assert worker.received_request is request


def test_executor_rejects_unknown_task_type() -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()

    with pytest.raises(UnknownTaskTypeError):
        executor.execute(make_request())


def test_executor_rejects_duplicate_registration() -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()
    executor.register("demo", FakeWorker())

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="already registered"):
        executor.register("demo", FakeWorker())


def test_executor_rejects_blank_task_type_registration() -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must not be blank"):
        executor.register("   ", FakeWorker())


def test_executor_rejects_mismatched_result_task_id() -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()
    executor.register("demo", FakeWorker(make_result("another-task")))

    with pytest.raises(TaskResultContractError, match="task_id"):
        executor.execute(make_request())


def test_executor_rejects_non_task_result() -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()
    executor.register("demo", FakeWorker({"status": "completed"}))

    with pytest.raises(TaskResultContractError, match="must return a TaskResult"):
        executor.execute(make_request())


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "status",
    [TaskStatus.PENDING, TaskStatus.RUNNING],
)
def test_executor_rejects_non_final_status(
    status: TaskStatus,
) -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()
    executor.register("demo", FakeWorker(make_result(status=status)))

    with pytest.raises(TaskResultContractError, match="final task status"):
        executor.execute(make_request())


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "status",
    [TaskStatus.COMPLETED, TaskStatus.PARTIAL, TaskStatus.FAILED],
)
def test_executor_accepts_final_statuses(status: TaskStatus) -> None:
    executor = TaskExecutor()
    executor.register("demo", FakeWorker(make_result(status=status)))

    result = executor.execute(make_request())

    assert result.status == status

CODE:
"""Tests for the orchestration service."""

import pytest

from vigil.orchestration.executor import (
    TaskExecutor,
    TaskResultContractError,
    UnknownTaskTypeError,
    WorkerExecutionError,
)
from vigil.orchestration.investigation_state import (
    InvestigationState,
    InvestigationStatus,
)
from vigil.orchestration.service import (
    DuplicateTaskError,
    InvalidInvestigationStateError,
    OrchestrationService,
)
from vigil.orchestration.task_types import (
    ErrorDetail,
    TaskRequest,
    TaskResult,
    TaskStatus,
)
from vigil.orchestration.transitions import transition_state


def make_request(
    task_id: str = "task-001",
    task_type: str = "demo",
) -> TaskRequest:
    """Build a valid task request."""
    return TaskRequest(
        task_id=task_id,
        task_type=task_type,
        input_refs=[],
        parameters={},
    )


def make_state() -> InvestigationState:
    """Build a new investigation state."""
    return InvestigationState(investigation_id="inv-001")


def make_result(
    task_id: str = "task-001",
    status: TaskStatus = TaskStatus.COMPLETED,
) -> TaskResult:
    """Build a valid task result."""
    error = (
        ErrorDetail(
            code="TEST_ERROR",
            message="Simulated task failure.",
            retryable=False,
        )
        if status == TaskStatus.FAILED
        else None
    )

    return TaskResult(
        task_id=task_id,
        status=status,
        output_refs=[],
        error=error,
    )


class FakeWorker:
    """Worker returning a predetermined result."""

    def __init__(self, result: TaskResult) -> None:
        self.result = result
        self.calls = 0

    def execute(self, request: TaskRequest) -> TaskResult:
        self.calls += 1
        return self.result


class RaisingWorker:
    """Worker simulating a reported execution failure."""

    def execute(self, request: TaskRequest) -> TaskResult:
        raise WorkerExecutionError("Simulated worker execution failure")


def make_service(worker: object) -> OrchestrationService:
    """Build a service with one registered demo worker."""
    executor = TaskExecutor()
    executor.register("demo", worker)
    return OrchestrationService(executor)


def test_task_completion_does_not_finish_investigation() -> None:
    worker = FakeWorker(make_result())
    service = make_service(worker)
    original = make_state()

    outcome = service.execute_task(original, make_request())

    assert outcome.task_result.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED
    assert outcome.state.status == InvestigationStatus.RUNNING
    assert outcome.state.task_ids == ["task-001"]
    assert outcome.state.started_at is not None
    assert outcome.state.completed_at is None

    completed_state = service.complete_investigation(outcome.state)

    assert completed_state.status == InvestigationStatus.COMPLETED
    assert completed_state.completed_at is not None

    # The original immutable state must remain unchanged.
    assert original.status == InvestigationStatus.CREATED
    assert original.task_ids == []
    assert worker.calls == 1


def test_partial_task_keeps_investigation_running() -> None:
    worker = FakeWorker(make_result(status=TaskStatus.PARTIAL))
    service = make_service(worker)

    outcome = service.execute_task(make_state(), make_request())

    assert outcome.task_result.status == TaskStatus.PARTIAL
    assert outcome.state.status == InvestigationStatus.RUNNING
    assert outcome.state.task_ids == ["task-001"]
    assert outcome.state.completed_at is None


def test_failed_task_fails_investigation() -> None:
    worker = FakeWorker(make_result(status=TaskStatus.FAILED))
    service = make_service(worker)

    outcome = service.execute_task(make_state(), make_request())

    assert outcome.task_result.status == TaskStatus.FAILED
    assert outcome.task_result.error is not None
    assert outcome.state.status == InvestigationStatus.FAILED
    assert outcome.state.task_ids == ["task-001"]
    assert outcome.state.completed_at is not None


def test_worker_execution_error_becomes_failed_result() -> None:
    service = make_service(RaisingWorker())

    outcome = service.execute_task(make_state(), make_request())

    assert outcome.task_result.status == TaskStatus.FAILED
    assert outcome.task_result.error is not None
    assert outcome.task_result.error.code == "WORKER_EXECUTION_ERROR"
    assert outcome.task_result.started_at is not None
    assert outcome.task_result.completed_at is not None
    assert outcome.state.status == InvestigationStatus.FAILED


def test_unknown_task_type_propagates() -> None:
    service = OrchestrationService(TaskExecutor())

    with pytest.raises(UnknownTaskTypeError):
        service.execute_task(make_state(), make_request())


def test_worker_result_contract_violation_propagates() -> None:
    worker = FakeWorker(make_result(task_id="another-task"))
    service = make_service(worker)

    with pytest.raises(TaskResultContractError):
        service.execute_task(make_state(), make_request())


def test_duplicate_task_id_is_rejected_before_execution() -> None:
    worker = FakeWorker(make_result())
    service = make_service(worker)
    state = make_state().model_copy(update={"task_ids": ["task-001"]})

    with pytest.raises(DuplicateTaskError):
        service.execute_task(state, make_request())

    assert worker.calls == 0


def test_paused_investigation_is_rejected() -> None:
    worker = FakeWorker(make_result())
    service = make_service(worker)

    running_state = transition_state(
        make_state(),
        InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
    )
    paused_state = transition_state(
        running_state,
        InvestigationStatus.PAUSED,
    )

    with pytest.raises(InvalidInvestigationStateError):
        service.execute_task(paused_state, make_request())

    assert worker.calls == 0


def test_unexpected_programming_error_propagates() -> None:
    class BuggyWorker:
        def execute(self, request: TaskRequest) -> TaskResult:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected programming error")

    service = make_service(BuggyWorker())

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Unexpected programming error"):
        service.execute_task(make_state(), make_request())


def test_complete_investigation_rejects_created_state() -> None:
    service = make_service(FakeWorker(make_result()))

    with pytest.raises(InvalidInvestigationStateError):
        service.complete_investigation(make_state())

PATH - tests\unit\orchestration\test_transitions.py
CODE:
"""Tests for investigation state transitions."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

import pytest

from vigil.orchestration.investigation_state import (
    InvestigationState,
    InvestigationStatus,
)
from vigil.orchestration.transitions import (
    InvalidStateTransitionError,
    transition_state,
)


def make_state() -> InvestigationState:
    """Create an initial investigation state."""
    return InvestigationState(investigation_id="inv-001")


def test_created_investigation_can_start() -> None:
    original = make_state()

    updated = transition_state(
        original,
        InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
    )

    assert updated.status == InvestigationStatus.RUNNING
    assert updated.started_at is not None
    assert updated.completed_at is None
    assert updated.updated_at >= updated.started_at
    assert original.status == InvestigationStatus.CREATED
    assert original.started_at is None


def test_running_investigation_can_pause() -> None:
    running = transition_state(
        make_state(),
        InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
    )

    paused = transition_state(
        running,
        InvestigationStatus.PAUSED,
    )

    assert paused.status == InvestigationStatus.PAUSED
    assert paused.started_at == running.started_at
    assert paused.completed_at is None


def test_paused_investigation_can_resume() -> None:
    running = transition_state(
        make_state(),
        InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
    )
    paused = transition_state(
        running,
        InvestigationStatus.PAUSED,
    )

    resumed = transition_state(
        paused,
        InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
    )

    assert resumed.status == InvestigationStatus.RUNNING
    assert resumed.started_at == running.started_at
    assert resumed.completed_at is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "terminal_status",
    [
        InvestigationStatus.COMPLETED,
        InvestigationStatus.FAILED,
    ],
)
def test_running_investigation_can_reach_terminal_status(
    terminal_status: InvestigationStatus,
) -> None:
    running = transition_state(
        make_state(),
        InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
    )

    terminal = transition_state(running, terminal_status)

    assert terminal.status == terminal_status
    assert terminal.completed_at is not None
    assert terminal.completed_at >= terminal.started_at


def test_created_investigation_can_fail() -> None:
    failed = transition_state(
        make_state(),
        InvestigationStatus.FAILED,
    )

    assert failed.status == InvestigationStatus.FAILED
    assert failed.completed_at is not None
    assert failed.started_at is None


def test_paused_investigation_can_fail() -> None:
    running = transition_state(
        make_state(),
        InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
    )
    paused = transition_state(
        running,
        InvestigationStatus.PAUSED,
    )

    failed = transition_state(
        paused,
        InvestigationStatus.FAILED,
    )

    assert failed.status == InvestigationStatus.FAILED
    assert failed.started_at == running.started_at
    assert failed.completed_at is not None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("initial_status", "target_status"),
    [
        (InvestigationStatus.CREATED, InvestigationStatus.PAUSED),
        (InvestigationStatus.RUNNING, InvestigationStatus.CREATED),
        (InvestigationStatus.PAUSED, InvestigationStatus.COMPLETED),
        (InvestigationStatus.COMPLETED, InvestigationStatus.RUNNING),
        (InvestigationStatus.FAILED, InvestigationStatus.RUNNING),
    ],
)
def test_invalid_transition_is_rejected(
    initial_status: InvestigationStatus,
    target_status: InvestigationStatus,
) -> None:
    state_data: dict[str, object] = {
        "investigation_id": "inv-001",
        "status": initial_status,
    }

    # The existing schema requires completion timestamps for terminal states.
    if initial_status in {
        InvestigationStatus.COMPLETED,
        InvestigationStatus.FAILED,
    }:
        state_data["completed_at"] = datetime.now(UTC)

    state = InvestigationState.model_validate(state_data)

    with pytest.raises(InvalidStateTransitionError):
        transition_state(state, target_status)


def test_transition_does_not_mutate_original_state() -> None:
    original = make_state()

    transition_state(original, InvestigationStatus.RUNNING)

    assert original.status == InvestigationStatus.CREATED
    assert original.started_at is None

def test_export_html_contains_required_sections() -> None:

    )

            ],
            provenance=Provenance(
                producer_type="vision_model",
                producer_name="vigil-vision",
                method="detection",
            ),
        ),
    ]
    assessments = [
        EvidenceAssessment(
            assessment_id="ass-01",
            target_type="event",
            target_id="evt-01",
            assessment_type="support_level",
            rating="high",
            rationale="Corroborated by high-contrast night vision frames.",

        )
    ]
    coverages = [

        )
    ]
    artifacts = [
        Artifact(

            artifact_type="clip",

        )
    ]
    audit_logs = [
        AuditLog(
            audit_id="audit-exp-01",
            investigation_id="inv-exp-01",
            action="event_review",
            actor="detective-shaw",

    html_out = ReportExporter.export_html(

    assert "<!DOCTYPE html>" in html_out

    assert "Executive Summary" in html_out
    assert "perimeter_breach" in html_out or "Perimeter Breach" in html_out
    assert "CONFIRMED" in html_out
    assert "REJECTED" in html_out
    assert "<video" in html_out
    assert "clip-exp-01" in html_out
    assert "detective-shaw" in html_out
    assert "audit-exp-01" in html_out or "event_review" in html_out

def test_export_pdf_with_large_multipage_markdown_summary() -> None:
    now = datetime(2026, 10, 20, 15, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-pdf-large",
        title="Multi-page PDF Export Case",
        objective="Verify multi-page markdown summary renders without LayoutError",
        scope_description="All Feeds",
        media_asset_ids=["media-01"],
    )

    # Construct a long structured summary matching LLM output (tallest row > 700 points)
    summary_parts = [
        "### 1. Objective Finding & Direct Answer",
        "- **Primary finding:** Comprehensive multi-modal forensic evaluation confirmed unauthorized access.",
        "- **Direct Answer:** Subject breached perimeter fence at 00:14:02.",
        "### 2. Multi-Modal Timeline & Chronological Sequence",
    ]
    for i in range(40):
        summary_parts.append(
            f"- **Timestamp [{i*2}.0s]:** Detection of physical movement across camera CAM-{i%3 + 1}. "
            f"Confidence score evaluated at 0.9{i%10}. Acoustic Demux corroborates transient waveform."
        )
    summary_parts.extend([
        "### 3. Evidentiary Confidence & Quality Assessment",
        "The evidentiary quality rating is designated HIGH across visual and audio spectrums.",
        "### 4. Investigative Conclusion & Next Steps",
        "Case closed and deliverables exported.",
    ])
    large_summary = "\n".join(summary_parts)

    report = Report(
        report_id="rep-pdf-large",
        investigation_id="inv-pdf-large",
        title="Forensic Investigation Comprehensive Report",
        summary=large_summary,
        generated_by="vigil-reporter",
        version=1,
        status="finalized",
        finalized_by="lead-inspector",
        finalized_at=now,
    )

    pdf_bytes = ReportExporter.export_pdf(
        investigation=inv,
        report=report,
        events=[],
        observations=[],
        assessments=[],
        coverages=[],
        artifacts=[],
        audit_logs=[],
        media_assets=[],
    )

    assert isinstance(pdf_bytes, bytes)
    assert len(pdf_bytes) > 2000
    assert pdf_bytes.startswith(b"%PDF-")

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from tests.media_test_helpers import create_test_video
from vigil.domain.event import Event

    InvestigationStatus,
)

def test_review_event_workflow(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = SqliteInvestigationRepository(":memory:")
    service = InvestigationService(repository=repo, storage_dir=tmp_path / "storage")

    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-rev-01",
        title="Review Test Case",
        objective="Verify suspect movement",
        scope_description="Gate camera",
        media_asset_ids=["media-01"],
    )
    repo.add_investigation(inv)
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    state = InvestigationState(
        investigation_id="inv-rev-01",
        status=InvestigationStatus.COMPLETED,
        completed_at=now,
        event_ids=["evt-01"],
    )
    repo.save_state(state)

    event = Event(
        event_id="evt-01",
        event_type="fence_crossing",
        description="Possible fence crossing detected.",
        observation_ids=["obs-01"],
        status="proposed",
    )
    repo.add_event(event)

    # 1. Review event -> confirmed
    updated_evt, audit_entry = service.review_event(
        investigation_id="inv-rev-01",
        event_id="evt-01",
        status="confirmed",
        reviewer="detective-reese",
        notes="Confirmed breach by intruder wearing dark hoodie.",
        description="Confirmed south perimeter breach.",
    )

    assert updated_evt.status == "confirmed"
    assert updated_evt.reviewer == "detective-reese"
    assert updated_evt.review_notes == "Confirmed breach by intruder wearing dark hoodie."
    assert updated_evt.description == "Confirmed south perimeter breach."
    assert updated_evt.reviewed_at is not None

    assert audit_entry.action == "event_review"
    assert audit_entry.actor == "detective-reese"
    assert audit_entry.changes["status"]["old"] == "proposed"
    assert audit_entry.changes["status"]["new"] == "confirmed"

    # 2. Check audit log query
    logs = service.get_audit_logs("inv-rev-01")
    assert len(logs) == 1
    assert logs[0].audit_id == audit_entry.audit_id

    service.shutdown(wait=False)

PATH - tests\unit\storage\test_audit_repository.py
CODE:
"""Unit tests for audit log storage in memory and SQLite repositories."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from vigil.domain.audit import AuditLog
from vigil.storage.repository import InvestigationRepository
from vigil.storage.sqlite_repository import SqliteInvestigationRepository


def test_in_memory_repository_audit_logging() -> None:
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    t1 = datetime(2026, 10, 20, 10, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
    t2 = datetime(2026, 10, 20, 10, 5, tzinfo=UTC)

    log1 = AuditLog(
        audit_id="audit-001",
        investigation_id="inv-001",
        action="event_review",
        actor="user-alice",
        timestamp=t1,
        target_type="event",
        target_id="evt-001",
        changes={"status": {"old": "proposed", "new": "confirmed"}},
        notes="Verified",
    )
    log2 = AuditLog(
        audit_id="audit-002",
        investigation_id="inv-001",
        action="report_finalize",
        actor="user-bob",
        timestamp=t2,
        target_type="report",
        target_id="rep-001",
        changes={"version": {"old": 1, "new": 2}},
    )

    repo.add_audit_log(log1)
    repo.add_audit_log(log2)

    assert repo.get_audit_log("audit-001").actor == "user-alice"
    assert repo.get_audit_log("audit-002").target_id == "rep-001"

    logs = repo.list_audit_logs("inv-001")
    assert len(logs) == 2
    assert logs[0].audit_id == "audit-001"
    assert logs[1].audit_id == "audit-002"

    target_logs = repo.list_audit_logs("inv-001", target_id="evt-001")
    assert len(target_logs) == 1
    assert target_logs[0].audit_id == "audit-001"


def test_sqlite_repository_audit_logging(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db_file = tmp_path / "audit_test.db"
    repo = SqliteInvestigationRepository(db_path=db_file)

    t1 = datetime(2026, 10, 20, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
    t2 = datetime(2026, 10, 20, 12, 10, tzinfo=UTC)

    log1 = AuditLog(
        audit_id="audit-101",
        investigation_id="inv-500",
        action="event_review",
        actor="badge-701",
        timestamp=t1,
        target_type="event",
        target_id="evt-501",
        changes={"status": {"old": "proposed", "new": "rejected"}},
        notes="False positive: animal triggered motion",
    )
    log2 = AuditLog(
        audit_id="audit-102",
        investigation_id="inv-500",
        action="report_finalize",
        actor="badge-701",
        timestamp=t2,
        target_type="report",
        target_id="rep-500",
        changes={"status": {"old": "draft", "new": "finalized"}},
    )

    repo.add_audit_log(log1)
    repo.add_audit_log(log2)

    # Re-open repo from file to test persistence across connections
    repo.close()
    reloaded_repo = SqliteInvestigationRepository(db_path=db_file)

    fetched1 = reloaded_repo.get_audit_log("audit-101")
    assert fetched1.actor == "badge-701"
    assert fetched1.action == "event_review"
    assert fetched1.notes == "False positive: animal triggered motion"

    all_logs = reloaded_repo.list_audit_logs(investigation_id="inv-500")
    assert len(all_logs) == 2
    assert all_logs[0].audit_id == "audit-101"
    assert all_logs[1].audit_id == "audit-102"
    reloaded_repo.close()

"""Tests for InvestigationRepository and referential checks."""

import pytest

from vigil.domain.camera import Camera
from vigil.domain.media_asset import MediaAsset
from vigil.storage.repository import (
    EntityNotFoundError,
    InvestigationRepository,
    ReferentialIntegrityError,
)


def test_repository_media_asset_and_camera() -> None:
    repo = InvestigationRepository()

    cam = Camera(camera_id="cam-001", name="Front Gate Camera")
    repo.add_camera(cam)
    assert repo.get_camera("cam-001").name == "Front Gate Camera"

    asset = MediaAsset(
        media_asset_id="media-001",
        media_type="video",
        storage_uri="file:///media/feed1.mp4",
        camera_id="cam-001",
        duration_seconds=60.0,
    )
    repo.add_media_asset(asset)
    assert repo.get_media_asset("media-001").duration_seconds == 60.0


def test_repository_missing_entity_raises() -> None:
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    with pytest.raises(EntityNotFoundError):
        repo.get_camera("non-existent-cam")


def test_repository_referential_integrity() -> None:
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    asset = MediaAsset(
        media_asset_id="media-001",
        media_type="video",
        storage_uri="file:///media/feed1.mp4",
    )
    repo.add_media_asset(asset)

    # Valid check
    repo.validate_references_exist(["media-001"], expected_type="media_asset")

    # Invalid check
    with pytest.raises(ReferentialIntegrityError):
        repo.validate_references_exist(["media-missing"], expected_type="media_asset")


def test_repository_list_investigations() -> None:

    inv1 = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-1",

        objective="Obj 1",
        scope_description="Scope 1",
    )
    repo.add_investigation(inv1)
    assert len(repo.list_investigations()) == 1
    assert repo.list_investigations()[0].investigation_id == "inv-1"

def test_sqlite_repository_persistence_across_restarts(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    db_file = tmp_path / "vigil_investigation.db"
    now = datetime.now(UTC)

    # 1. First session: insert data
    with SqliteInvestigationRepository(db_file) as repo1:
        cam = Camera(camera_id="cam-002", name="Lobby")
        repo1.add_camera(cam)

        asset = MediaAsset(
            media_asset_id="media-002",
            media_type="video",
            storage_uri="file:///media/lobby.mp4",
            camera_id="cam-002",
            duration_seconds=45.0,
        )
        repo1.add_media_asset(asset)

        source_ref = SourceReference(
            media_asset_id="media-002",
            start_seconds=10.0,
            end_seconds=15.0,
        )
        art = Artifact(
            artifact_id="art-001",
            artifact_type="frame",
            media_type="image",
            storage_uri="file:///artifacts/lobby_f1.jpg",
            source_reference=source_ref,
        )
        repo1.add_artifact(art)

        prov = Provenance(
            producer_type="vision_model",
            producer_name="test_detector",
            method="unit_test",
        )
        obs = Observation(
            observation_id="obs-001",
            modality="image",
            observation_type="detection",
            description="Person entering lobby",
            source_references=[source_ref],
            confidence=0.92,
            provenance=prov,
        )
        repo1.add_observation(obs)

        ent = Entity(
            entity_id="ent-001",
            entity_type="person",
            label="Suspicious individual",
            associated_observation_ids=["obs-001"],
        )
        repo1.add_entity(ent)

        evt = Event(
            event_id="evt-001",
            event_type="entrance",
            description="Person entering lobby",
            observation_ids=["obs-001"],
            status="confirmed",
        )
        repo1.add_event(evt)

        inv = Investigation(
            investigation_id="inv-001",
            title="Lobby Security Incident",
            objective="Identify unauthorized individuals in lobby",
            scope_description="Footage from lobby camera between 10s and 45s",
        )
        repo1.add_investigation(inv)

        from vigil.domain.coverage import CoverageRecord, CoverageStatus
        cov = CoverageRecord(
            coverage_id="cov-001",
            investigation_id="inv-001",
            source_reference_id="ref-001",
            status=CoverageStatus.EXAMINED,
            examined_at=now,
        )
        repo1.add_coverage_record(cov)

        state = InvestigationState(
            investigation_id="inv-001",
            status=InvestigationStatus.RUNNING,
            task_ids=["task-1"],
            observation_ids=["obs-001"],
            event_ids=["evt-001"],
            started_at=now,
        )
        repo1.save_state(state)

    # 2. Second session: re-open DB and verify data persisted across restart
    with SqliteInvestigationRepository(db_file) as repo2:
        assert repo2.get_camera("cam-002").name == "Lobby"
        assert repo2.get_media_asset("media-002").duration_seconds == 45.0
        assert repo2.get_artifact("art-001").artifact_type == "frame"
        assert repo2.get_observation("obs-001").confidence == 0.92
        assert repo2.get_entity("ent-001").label == "Suspicious individual"
        assert repo2.get_event("evt-001").event_type == "entrance"
        assert repo2.get_investigation("inv-001").title == "Lobby Security Incident"
        assert len(repo2.list_coverage_records("inv-001")) == 1

        state2 = repo2.get_state("inv-001")
        assert state2 is not None
        assert state2.status == InvestigationStatus.RUNNING
        assert state2.event_ids == ["evt-001"]

def test_cli_parser_building() -> None:

def test_cli_review_and_audit_execution(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
    db_file = tmp_path / "cli_test.db"
    repo = SqliteInvestigationRepository(db_path=db_file)
    service = InvestigationService(repository=repo, storage_dir=tmp_path / "storage")

    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-cli-01",
        title="CLI Investigation",
        objective="Test CLI review workflows",
        scope_description="Testing",
        media_asset_ids=["media-01"],
    )
    repo.add_investigation(inv)
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    state = InvestigationState(
        investigation_id="inv-cli-01",
        status=InvestigationStatus.COMPLETED,
        completed_at=now,
        event_ids=["evt-cli-01"],
    )
    repo.save_state(state)
    event = Event(
        event_id="evt-cli-01",
        event_type="perimeter_breach",
        description="Gate breach",
        observation_ids=["obs-01"],
        status="proposed",
    )
    repo.add_event(event)

    with patch("vigil.cli.create_cli_service", return_value=service):
        # 1. Review event
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", [
            "vigil", "review", "event", "inv-cli-01", "evt-cli-01",
            "--status", "confirmed",
            "--reviewer", "investigator-brown",
            "--notes", "Confirmed from CCTV footage",
        ]):
            main()
            captured = capsys.readouterr()
            assert "[SUCCESS]" in captured.out
            assert "CONFIRMED" in captured.out

        # 2. List events
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", [
            "vigil", "review", "list-events", "inv-cli-01",
        ]):
            main()
            captured = capsys.readouterr()
            assert "evt-cli-01" in captured.out
            assert "CONFIRMED" in captured.out

        # 3. Audit logs
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", [
            "vigil", "audit", "inv-cli-01",
        ]):
            main()
            captured = capsys.readouterr()
            assert "investigator-br" in captured.out or "investigator-brown" in captured.out
            assert "event_review" in captured.out

        # 4. Finalize report
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", [
            "vigil", "finalize-report", "inv-cli-01",
            "--finalized-by", "chief-inspector",
            "--no-clips",
        ]):
            main()
            captured = capsys.readouterr()
            assert "[SUCCESS]" in captured.out
            assert "chief-inspector" in captured.out

        # 5. Export HTML
        out_html = tmp_path / "report.html"
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", [
            "vigil", "export", "inv-cli-01",
            "--format", "html",
            "--output", str(out_html),
        ]):
            main()
            captured = capsys.readouterr()
            assert "[SUCCESS]" in captured.out
            assert out_html.is_file()
            assert "<!DOCTYPE html>" in out_html.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        # 6. Export PDF
        out_pdf = tmp_path / "report.pdf"
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", [
            "vigil", "export", "inv-cli-01",
            "--format", "pdf",
            "--output", str(out_pdf),
        ]):
            main()
            captured = capsys.readouterr()
            assert "[SUCCESS]" in captured.out
            assert out_pdf.is_file()
            assert out_pdf.read_bytes().startswith(b"%PDF-")

    resolve_or_create_entity,
)


def _create_test_image(path: Path) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    img = Image.new("RGB", (320, 240), color=(60, 90, 140))
    img.save(str(path), format="JPEG")
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Issue 3: Observation Normalization & Cleanup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_normalize_observation_description_clean_idempotence() -> None:
    """An already clean, grammatical forensic observation description must remain unchanged."""
    clean_desc = "Adult male in dark jacket and denim trousers walking eastward."
    assert normalize_observation_description(clean_desc) == clean_desc
    # Running multiple times must yield the exact same string
    assert normalize_observation_description(normalize_observation_description(clean_desc)) == clean_desc


def test_normalize_observation_description_unwraps_code_fences_and_json() -> None:
    """Raw JSON wrapped in markdown code fences must be converted to readable observation text."""
    raw_fenced = (
        "```json\n"
        "{\n"
        '  "observation_type": "person_detection",\n'
        '  "description": "Adult male in dark jacket walking toward security checkpoint.",\n'
        '  "confidence": 0.95\n'
        "}\n"
        "```"
    )
    result = normalize_observation_description(raw_fenced)
    assert result == "Adult male in dark jacket walking toward security checkpoint."


def test_normalize_observation_description_strips_model_boilerplate() -> None:
    """Common model preamble boilerplate phrases must be removed while keeping findings."""
    raw_preamble = (
        "Based on the visual evidence in the provided frame, "
        "a white 4-door sedan is parked in front of the bay door."
    )
    result = normalize_observation_description(raw_preamble)
    assert result == "A white 4-door sedan is parked in front of the bay door."

    raw_shows = "The surveillance video footage reveals an unauthorized entry through the north perimeter gate."
    result2 = normalize_observation_description(raw_shows)
    assert result2 == "An unauthorized entry through the north perimeter gate."


def test_normalize_observation_description_preserves_camera_prefix() -> None:
    """Camera context prefixes like [cam-01: Main Gate] must be preserved at the beginning."""
    raw_with_cam = (
        "[cam-01: Main Gate] In this surveillance frame, "
        "a subject approaches the electronic badge terminal."
    )
    result = normalize_observation_description(raw_with_cam)
    assert result.startswith("[cam-01: Main Gate] ")
    assert "In this surveillance frame" not in result
    assert "A subject approaches the electronic badge terminal." in result


def test_normalize_observation_description_handles_malformed_and_empty() -> None:
    """Empty, whitespace-only, or broken JSON syntax falls back safely without raising exceptions."""
    assert normalize_observation_description("") == ""
    assert normalize_observation_description("   ") == ""
    fallback = normalize_observation_description("{[]}")
    assert fallback == "Visual features observed in frame."

# Issue 2: VLM Parsing & Entity Extraction

def test_parse_vlm_detection_response_structured_json() -> None:
    """Structured JSON with observations and entities is parsed cleanly."""
    raw_json = json.dumps({
        "observations": [
            {
                "observation_type": "person_detection",
                "description": "Individual in high-visibility vest entering loading area.",
                "confidence": 0.92,
                "entity": {
                    "entity_type": "person",
                    "label": "Worker-1",
                    "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "orange vest", "role": "maintenance"},
                },
            }
        ],
        "entities": [
            {
                "entity_type": "vehicle",
                "label": "Forklift-1",
                "attributes": {"color": "yellow"},
            }
        ],
    })

    obs_data, ent_data = parse_vlm_detection_response(raw_json)
    assert len(obs_data) == 1
    assert obs_data[0]["observation_type"] == "person_detection"
    # One from observation, one top-level
    assert len(ent_data) == 2
    types = {e["entity_type"] for e in ent_data}
    assert "person" in types
    assert "vehicle" in types


def test_parse_vlm_detection_response_markdown_wrapped() -> None:
    """JSON enclosed within preamble text and markdown code fences is parsed accurately."""
    content = (
        "Here is the forensic visual analysis for the provided frame:\n\n"
        "```json\n"
        "{\n"
        '  "observations": [\n'
        '    {\n'
        '      "observation_type": "vehicle_detection",\n'
        '      "description": "Black SUV parked near emergency exit.",\n'
        '      "confidence": 0.88,\n'
        '      "entity": {\n'
        '        "entity_type": "vehicle",\n'
        '        "label": "Vehicle-9",\n'
        '        "attributes": {"color": "black", "vehicle_type": "SUV"}\n'
        '      }\n'
        '    }\n'
        '  ]\n'
        "}\n"
        "```\n"
        "Analysis complete."
    )
    obs_data, ent_data = parse_vlm_detection_response(content)
    assert len(obs_data) == 1
    assert obs_data[0]["description"] == "Black SUV parked near emergency exit."
    assert len(ent_data) == 1
    assert ent_data[0]["label"] == "Vehicle-9"


def test_parse_vlm_detection_response_free_text_narrative() -> None:
    """When a model responds with plain English narrative, observations and entities are still recovered."""
    narrative = (
        "The frame shows an adult person walking near the perimeter fence. "
        "A white vehicle is stationary in the background."
    )
    obs_data, ent_data = parse_vlm_detection_response(narrative)
    assert len(obs_data) >= 1
    assert "person" in obs_data[0]["description"].lower()
    # Should identify candidate entities from narrative mentions
    labels = [e.get("label") for e in ent_data]
    assert any("Person" in str(l) for l in labels)
    assert any("Vehicle" in str(l) for l in labels)


def test_resolve_or_create_entity_string_and_synonym_support() -> None:
    """String descriptors and category synonyms are safely mapped to valid entity types."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    active: dict[str, Entity] = {}

    # String input with vehicle keyword
    ent_str = resolve_or_create_entity(repo, "White delivery truck", "obs-t1", active)
    assert ent_str.entity_type == "vehicle"
    assert ent_str.label == "White delivery truck"

    # Dict with category synonym 'human'
    ent_human = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"category": "human", "label": "Guard-1", "attributes": {"uniform": "blue"}},
        "obs-t2",
        active,
    )
    assert ent_human.entity_type == "person"
    assert ent_human.label == "Guard-1"


def test_visual_detector_worker_creates_and_links_entities(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """VisualDetectorWorker must persist normalized observations and linked entities."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()

    img_path = tmp_path / "frame_det.jpg"
    _create_test_image(img_path)

    media = MediaAsset(media_asset_id="media-01", media_type="video", storage_uri="file:///v.mp4")
    repo.add_media_asset(media)

    art = Artifact(
        artifact_id="art-det-01",
        artifact_type="frame",
        media_type="image",
        storage_uri=img_path.as_uri(),
        source_reference=SourceReference(media_asset_id="media-01", start_seconds=5.0, end_seconds=5.5),
    )
    repo.add_artifact(art)

    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-det-test",
        title="Detector Integration",
        objective="Identify all persons and vehicles",
        scope_description="Testing frame detection",
        media_asset_ids=["media-01"],
    )
    repo.add_investigation(inv)

    worker = VisualDetectorWorker(repository=repo, llm_client=MockLLMClient())
    request = TaskRequest(
        task_id="task-det-01",
        task_type="visual_analysis",
        input_refs=[art.artifact_id],
        parameters={"investigation_id": inv.investigation_id},
    )

    obs_ids = worker.run(request)
    assert len(obs_ids) >= 1

    # Verify observations in repository
    obs_list = repo.list_observations(obs_ids)
    for obs in obs_list:
        assert obs.artifact_ids == [art.artifact_id]
        # Description must be clean, not raw JSON
        assert not obs.description.startswith("{")
        assert not obs.description.startswith("```")

    # Verify entities in repository
    entities = repo.list_entities()
    assert len(entities) >= 1
    for ent in entities:
        # Entity must reference at least one generated observation ID
        assert any(oid in obs_ids for oid in ent.associated_observation_ids)


def test_visual_annotator_links_frame_to_resolved_entities(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """VisualEvidenceAnnotator connects selected incident frames to their existing resolved entities."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()

    img_path = tmp_path / "frame_ann.jpg"
    _create_test_image(img_path)

    media = MediaAsset(media_asset_id="media-ann-01", media_type="video", storage_uri="file:///v.mp4")
    repo.add_media_asset(media)

    art = Artifact(
        artifact_id="art-ann-01",
        artifact_type="frame",
        media_type="image",
        storage_uri=img_path.as_uri(),
        source_reference=SourceReference(media_asset_id="media-ann-01", start_seconds=2.0, end_seconds=2.5),
    )
    repo.add_artifact(art)

    obs = Observation(
        observation_id="obs-ann-01",
        modality="image",
        observation_type="person_detection",
        description="Adult male walking toward warehouse door.",
        source_references=[art.source_reference],
        artifact_ids=[art.artifact_id],
        confidence=0.93,
        provenance=Provenance(producer_type="vision_model", producer_name="vlm", method="detect"),
    )
    repo.add_observation(obs)

    ent = Entity(
        entity_id="ent-person-99",
        entity_type="person",
        label="Suspect-99",
        attributes={"clothing_upper": "grey hoodie"},
        associated_observation_ids=[obs.observation_id],
    )
    repo.add_entity(ent)

    annotator = VisualEvidenceAnnotator(
        repository=repo,
        llm_client=MockLLMClient(),
        storage_dir=tmp_path / "annotated",
    )

    item = annotator.annotate_frame(
        artifact=art,
        investigation_id="inv-ann-test",
        investigation_entities=[ent],
    )

    assert item.artifact_id == art.artifact_id
    # Resolved entity must be populated from the observation linked to this frame!
    assert "ent-person-99" in item.resolved_entity_ids
    assert "person" in item.tags

def test_report_exporter_renders_detected_entities_section(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Markdown, HTML, and PDF exports must render a dedicated Detected Entities section."""
    img_path = tmp_path / "frame_rep.jpg"
    _create_test_image(img_path)

    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-rep-test",
        title="Entity Reporting Case",
        objective="Identify all subjects on scene",
        scope_description="Surveillance report test",
        media_asset_ids=["media-rep-01"],
    )
    report = Report(
        report_id="rep-01",
        investigation_id="inv-rep-test",
        title="Formal Forensic Deliverable",
        summary="Investigation identified verified entities across examined camera feeds.",
        generated_by="lead-investigator",
        evidence_frame_artifact_ids=["art-rep-01"],
        visual_evidence=[
            {
                "artifact_id": "art-rep-01",
                "storage_uri": img_path.as_uri(),
                "original_storage_uri": img_path.as_uri(),
                "timestamp_seconds": 12.0,
                "caption": "Suspect observed walking near gate.",
                "tags": ["person", "suspect"],
                "resolved_entity_ids": ["ent-suspect-01"],
                "has_overlay": False,
            }
        ],
    )
    obs = Observation(
        observation_id="obs-rep-01",
        modality="image",
        observation_type="person_detection",
        description="Adult subject in dark outerwear walking north.",
        source_references=[SourceReference(media_asset_id="media-rep-01", start_seconds=12.0, end_seconds=12.5)],
        artifact_ids=["art-rep-01"],
        confidence=0.95,
        provenance=Provenance(producer_type="vision_model", producer_name="vlm", method="detect"),
    )
    ent = Entity(
        entity_id="ent-suspect-01",
        entity_type="person",
        label="Suspect-01",
        attributes={"clothing_upper": "dark jacket", "footwear": "boots"},
        associated_observation_ids=[obs.observation_id],
    )

    # 1. Markdown Export
    md_out = ReportExporter.export_markdown(
        investigation=inv,
        report=report,
        events=[],
        observations=[obs],
        assessments=[],
        coverages=[],
        artifacts=[],
        audit_logs=[],
        media_assets=[],
        entities=[ent],
    )
    assert "## 4. Detected Entities & Forensic Tracked Assets" in md_out
    assert "`ent-suspect-01`" in md_out
    assert "Suspect-01" in md_out
    assert "clothing_upper: dark jacket" in md_out
    assert "12.0s" in md_out

    # 2. HTML Export
    html_out = ReportExporter.export_html(
        investigation=inv,
        report=report,
        events=[],
        observations=[obs],
        assessments=[],
        coverages=[],
        artifacts=[],
        audit_logs=[],
        media_assets=[],
        entities=[ent],
    )
    assert "4. Detected Entities &amp; Tracked Forensic Assets" in html_out
    assert "ent-suspect-01" in html_out
    assert "Suspect-01" in html_out
    assert "clothing_upper: dark jacket" in html_out

    # 3. PDF Export
    pdf_bytes = ReportExporter.export_pdf(
        investigation=inv,
        report=report,
        events=[],
        observations=[obs],
        assessments=[],
        coverages=[],
        artifacts=[],
        audit_logs=[],
        media_assets=[],
        entities=[ent],
    )
    assert isinstance(pdf_bytes, bytes)
    assert pdf_bytes.startswith(b"%PDF-")

"""Unit tests for conservative entity resolution in VisualDetectorWorker."""

import pytest
from pathlib import Path

from vigil.domain.entity import Entity
from vigil.domain.media_asset import MediaAsset
from vigil.domain.observation import Observation
from vigil.domain.provenance import Provenance
from vigil.domain.source_reference import SourceReference
from vigil.storage.repository import InvestigationRepository
from vigil.storage.sqlite_repository import SqliteInvestigationRepository
from vigil.tools.visual_detector import resolve_or_create_entity


@pytest.mark.parametrize("repo_type", ["in_memory", "sqlite"])
def test_repeated_entity_observations_reuse_entity_id(tmp_path: Path, repo_type: str) -> None:
    """Repeated detections of the same specific entity must reuse the same entity ID."""
    if repo_type == "sqlite":
        repo = SqliteInvestigationRepository(tmp_path / "test.db")
    else:
        repo = InvestigationRepository()

    active_entities: dict[str, Entity] = {}

    entity_info_1 = {
        "entity_type": "person",
        "label": "Suspect-1",
        "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "dark jacket", "clothing_lower": "denim trousers"},
    }
    ent1 = resolve_or_create_entity(repo, entity_info_1, "obs-001", active_entities)
    assert ent1.entity_id.startswith("ent-")
    assert ent1.label == "Suspect-1"
    assert ent1.associated_observation_ids == ["obs-001"]

    # Second observation of Suspect-1 with additional attribute
    entity_info_2 = {
        "entity_type": "person",
        "label": "Suspect-1",
        "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "dark jacket", "footwear": "boots"},
    }
    ent2 = resolve_or_create_entity(repo, entity_info_2, "obs-002", active_entities)

    assert ent2.entity_id == ent1.entity_id
    assert set(ent2.associated_observation_ids) == {"obs-001", "obs-002"}
    assert ent2.attributes["clothing_upper"] == "dark jacket"
    assert ent2.attributes["clothing_lower"] == "denim trousers"
    assert ent2.attributes["footwear"] == "boots"

    # Verify repository state
    saved = repo.get_entity(ent1.entity_id)
    assert saved.entity_id == ent1.entity_id
    assert set(saved.associated_observation_ids) == {"obs-001", "obs-002"}
    assert len(repo.list_entities()) == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("repo_type", ["in_memory", "sqlite"])
def test_distinct_entities_are_not_merged(tmp_path: Path, repo_type: str) -> None:
    """Distinct entities (different types, labels, or conflicting attributes) must NOT be merged."""
    if repo_type == "sqlite":
        repo = SqliteInvestigationRepository(tmp_path / "test.db")
    else:
        repo = InvestigationRepository()

    active_entities: dict[str, Entity] = {}

    # Person 1: Suspect-1
    ent1 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_type": "person", "label": "Suspect-1", "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "black hoodie"}},
        "obs-01",
        active_entities,
    )

    # Person 2: Security-Guard
    ent2 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_type": "person", "label": "Security-Guard", "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "high-vis vest"}},
        "obs-02",
        active_entities,
    )

    # Person 3: Same label "Suspect-1" but conflicting clothing (red jacket vs black hoodie)
    ent3 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_type": "person", "label": "Suspect-1", "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "red jacket"}},
        "obs-03",
        active_entities,
    )

    # Vehicle: Vehicle-1
    ent4 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_type": "vehicle", "label": "Vehicle-1", "attributes": {"color": "white", "vehicle_type": "sedan"}},
        "obs-04",
        active_entities,
    )

    assert ent1.entity_id != ent2.entity_id
    assert ent1.entity_id != ent3.entity_id
    assert ent1.entity_id != ent4.entity_id
    assert len(repo.list_entities()) == 4


def test_generic_labels_without_strong_overlap_are_not_merged() -> None:
    """Generic labels like 'person' or 'vehicle' with single generic attributes are not merged."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    active_entities: dict[str, Entity] = {}

    ent1 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_type": "person", "label": "person", "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "dark jacket"}},
        "obs-01",
        active_entities,
    )

    ent2 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_type": "person", "label": "man", "attributes": {"clothing_upper": "dark jacket"}},
        "obs-02",
        active_entities,
    )

    # Because both labels are generic and only a single generic attribute matches,
    # conservative resolution preserves separate entities.
    assert ent1.entity_id != ent2.entity_id
    assert len(repo.list_entities()) == 2


def test_explicit_entity_id_reuse() -> None:
    """Explicit valid entity_id in entity_info is reused directly."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    active_entities: dict[str, Entity] = {}

    ent1 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_type": "vehicle", "label": "Delivery Van", "attributes": {"color": "blue"}},
        "obs-01",
        active_entities,
    )

    ent2 = resolve_or_create_entity(
        repo,
        {"entity_id": ent1.entity_id, "entity_type": "vehicle", "label": "Delivery Van", "attributes": {"make": "Ford"}},
        "obs-02",
        active_entities,
    )

    assert ent2.entity_id == ent1.entity_id
    assert set(ent2.associated_observation_ids) == {"obs-01", "obs-02"}
    assert ent2.attributes["color"] == "blue"
    assert ent2.attributes["make"] == "Ford"

def test_media_ingestion_worker(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    worker = MediaIngestionWorker(repository=repo, llm_client=MockLLMClient())

    video_path = tmp_path / "incoming_feed.mp4"

    req = TaskRequest(

        parameters={

            "sample_interval_seconds": 0.5,
            "max_frames": 3,
        },

    result = worker.execute(req)

    media_id = result.output_refs[0]
    asset = repo.get_media_asset(media_id)
    assert asset.camera_id == "cam-101"

    # Frame artifacts should be present
    for art_id in result.output_refs[1:]:
        art = repo.get_artifact(art_id)

        task_type="frame_sampling",
        input_refs=["media-real-1"],
        parameters={"sample_interval_seconds": 0.5, "max_frames": 3},
    )

    assert result.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED
    assert len(result.output_refs) > 0

    assert art.media_type == "image"

"""Unit tests for visual evidence selection, bounding box validation, and report integration."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from vigil.config import config
from vigil.domain.artifact import Artifact
from vigil.domain.entity import Entity
from vigil.domain.event import Event
from vigil.domain.investigation import Investigation
from vigil.domain.media_asset import MediaAsset
from vigil.domain.observation import Observation
from vigil.domain.provenance import Provenance
from vigil.domain.report import Report
from vigil.domain.source_reference import SourceReference
from vigil.domain.visual_evidence import (
    BoundingBox,
    VisualEvidenceItem,
    validate_coordinates,
)
from vigil.models.mock import MockLLMClient
from vigil.services.exporter import ReportExporter
from vigil.storage.repository import InvestigationRepository
from vigil.tools.visual_annotator import VisualEvidenceAnnotator


def _create_sample_image(path: Path, width: int = 640, height: int = 480, color: tuple = (50, 80, 120)) -> Path:
    """Create a dummy real image for Pillow overlay testing."""
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), color=color)
    img.save(str(path), format="JPEG")
    return path


def test_coordinate_validation() -> None:
    """Bounding box coordinates must be strictly validated for types, bounds, and ordering."""
    # Valid normalized box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]
    assert validate_coordinates([0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8]) == (0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8)

    # Valid dict format
    assert validate_coordinates({"x_min": 0.05, "y_min": 0.1, "x_max": 0.4, "y_max": 0.9}) == (0.05, 0.1, 0.4, 0.9)

    # Normalized 0-1000 scale
    assert validate_coordinates([100, 200, 500, 800]) == (0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8)

    # Invalid cases
    assert validate_coordinates([0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.8]) is None  # Inverted x (x_min > x_max)
    assert validate_coordinates([0.1, 0.8, 0.5, 0.2]) is None  # Inverted y (y_min > y_max)
    assert validate_coordinates([-0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8]) is None  # Out of bounds (<0)
    assert validate_coordinates([0.1, 0.2, 1.2, 0.8]) is None   # Out of bounds (>1)
    assert validate_coordinates([0.1, 0.2, float("inf"), 0.8]) is None  # Non-finite
    assert validate_coordinates(["0.1", 0.2, 0.5, 0.8]) is None  # Non-numeric
    assert validate_coordinates([0.1, 0.2, 0.1001, 0.8]) is None  # Collapsed width (< 0.005)
    assert validate_coordinates([0.1, 0.2, 0.5]) is None  # Wrong length


def test_select_incident_frames_respects_limit_and_boundaries(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Selection must pick top frames within configured limit, respecting media assets and diversity."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()

    asset1 = MediaAsset(media_asset_id="cam1-feed", media_type="video", storage_uri="file:///c1.mp4")
    asset2 = MediaAsset(media_asset_id="cam2-feed", media_type="video", storage_uri="file:///c2.mp4")
    unrelated_asset = MediaAsset(media_asset_id="unrelated-cam", media_type="video", storage_uri="file:///u.mp4")
    repo.add_media_asset(asset1)
    repo.add_media_asset(asset2)
    repo.add_media_asset(unrelated_asset)

    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-test-sel",
        title="Perimeter Test",
        objective="Determine suspect perimeter entry",
        scope_description="Perimeter cameras test scope",
        media_asset_ids=["cam1-feed", "cam2-feed"],
    )
    repo.add_investigation(inv)

    # Create 5 frames for cam1-feed at different timestamps
    frame_artifacts = []
    for i, t in enumerate([1.0, 1.2, 4.0, 8.0, 12.0]):
        art = Artifact(
            artifact_id=f"art-c1-{i}",
            artifact_type="frame",
            media_type="image",
            storage_uri=f"file:///frames/c1_{i}.jpg",
            source_reference=SourceReference(media_asset_id="cam1-feed", start_seconds=t, end_seconds=t + 0.5),
        )
        repo.add_artifact(art)
        frame_artifacts.append(art)

    # Create 1 frame for cam2-feed
    art_c2 = Artifact(
        artifact_id="art-c2-0",
        artifact_type="frame",
        media_type="image",
        storage_uri="file:///frames/c2_0.jpg",
        source_reference=SourceReference(media_asset_id="cam2-feed", start_seconds=5.0, end_seconds=5.5),
    )
    repo.add_artifact(art_c2)

    # Create 1 frame for unrelated asset (must never be selected)
    art_unrelated = Artifact(
        artifact_id="art-unrelated-0",
        artifact_type="frame",
        media_type="image",
        storage_uri="file:///frames/unrelated.jpg",
        source_reference=SourceReference(media_asset_id="unrelated-cam", start_seconds=2.0, end_seconds=2.5),
    )
    repo.add_artifact(art_unrelated)

    # Add an event for cam1 at t=4.0
    event = Event(
        event_id="evt-breach",
        event_type="perimeter_breach",
        description="Breach of south perimeter line.",
        status="confirmed",
        start_seconds=3.5,
        end_seconds=4.5,
        observation_ids=["obs-c1-2"],
    )
    repo.add_event(event)

    obs = Observation(
        observation_id="obs-c1-2",
        modality="image",
        observation_type="person_detection",
        description="Suspect crossing perimeter line",
        artifact_ids=["art-c1-2"],
        confidence=0.95,
        source_references=[SourceReference(media_asset_id="cam1-feed", start_seconds=4.0, end_seconds=4.5)],
        provenance=Provenance(producer_type="vision_model", producer_name="test", method="det"),
    )
    repo.add_observation(obs)

    annotator = VisualEvidenceAnnotator(repository=repo, storage_dir=tmp_path)

    # 1. Default limit of 3
    selected = annotator.select_incident_frames(investigation_id="inv-test-sel", max_frames=3)
    assert len(selected) == 3
    selected_ids = [a.artifact_id for a in selected]
    # art-c1-2 (confirmed event overlap at t=4.0) must be included
    assert "art-c1-2" in selected_ids
    # Unrelated media artifact must not be included
    assert "art-unrelated-0" not in selected_ids
    # Both cam1 and cam2 feeds should be represented due to diversity
    assert any(a.source_reference.media_asset_id == "cam1-feed" for a in selected)
    assert any(a.source_reference.media_asset_id == "cam2-feed" for a in selected)

    # 2. Configured limit of 2
    selected_2 = annotator.select_incident_frames(investigation_id="inv-test-sel", max_frames=2)
    assert len(selected_2) == 2


def test_select_incident_frames_handles_fewer_than_limit(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """If fewer frames exist than max_frames, all available are returned without error."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-single-frame",
        title="Single Frame Case",

        scope_description="Single frame test scope",
        media_asset_ids=["cam-single"],

    art = Artifact(

        artifact_type="frame",
        media_type="image",
        storage_uri="file:///single.jpg",
        source_reference=SourceReference(media_asset_id="cam-single", start_seconds=0.0, end_seconds=0.5),
    )
    repo.add_artifact(art)

    annotator = VisualEvidenceAnnotator(repository=repo, storage_dir=tmp_path)
    selected = annotator.select_incident_frames(investigation_id="inv-single-frame", max_frames=3)

def test_drawing_bounding_boxes_preserves_source_image(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Bounding box overlay must generate a derivative image without modifying the source image."""
    src_file = tmp_path / "original_frame.jpg"
    _create_sample_image(src_file, width=640, height=480, color=(100, 100, 100))
    original_bytes = src_file.read_bytes()

    out_file = tmp_path / "annotated_derivative.jpg"

    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    annotator = VisualEvidenceAnnotator(repository=repo, storage_dir=tmp_path)

    boxes = [
        BoundingBox(
            x_min=0.2,
            y_min=0.3,
            x_max=0.6,
            y_max=0.8,
            label="Suspect-1",
            category="person",
            confidence=0.92,
            valid=True,
        )
    ]

    success = annotator.draw_bounding_boxes(
        source_image_path=src_file,
        output_image_path=out_file,
        boxes=boxes,
    )

    assert success is True
    assert out_file.is_file()

    # Original file is byte-for-byte identical (unmodified)
    assert src_file.read_bytes() == original_bytes

    # Derivative image is valid and has expected dimensions
    with Image.open(out_file) as ann_img:
        assert ann_img.size == (640, 480)
        assert ann_img.format == "JPEG"


def test_synthetic_and_missing_artifacts_fallback_gracefully(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """Synthetic or non-existent file URIs do not attempt drawing and fall back safely."""
    repo = InvestigationRepository()
    annotator = VisualEvidenceAnnotator(
        repository=repo,
        llm_client=MockLLMClient(),
        storage_dir=tmp_path,
    )

    art = Artifact(
        artifact_id="art-synthetic-01",
        artifact_type="frame",
        media_type="image",
        storage_uri="file:///storage/synthetic/non_existent_frame.jpg",
        source_reference=SourceReference(media_asset_id="cam-syn", start_seconds=1.0, end_seconds=1.5),
    )
    repo.add_artifact(art)

    item = annotator.annotate_frame(
        artifact=art,
        investigation_id="inv-syn",
        investigation_entities=[],
    )

    assert item.artifact_id == "art-synthetic-01"
    assert item.has_overlay is False
    assert item.annotated_artifact_id is None
    assert item.storage_uri == art.storage_uri


def test_visual_evidence_in_html_and_pdf_exports(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """HTML and PDF exports correctly render visual evidence items with tags, entities, and disclaimer."""
    # Create real dummy frame and derivative
    src_file = tmp_path / "frame_real.jpg"
    _create_sample_image(src_file, 400, 300)

    ann_file = tmp_path / "frame_annotated.jpg"
    _create_sample_image(ann_file, 400, 300, color=(30, 60, 90))

    evidence_item = VisualEvidenceItem(
        artifact_id="art-evidence-01",
        annotated_artifact_id="art-ann-01",
        storage_uri=ann_file.as_uri(),
        original_storage_uri=src_file.as_uri(),
        media_asset_id="cam-north",
        camera_id="cam-north",
        camera_label="North Gate Entry",
        timestamp_seconds=14.5,
        caption="Suspect observed breaching north perimeter fence.",
        tags=["person", "perimeter_breach", "fence"],
        resolved_entity_ids=["ent-suspect-01"],
        bounding_boxes=[
            BoundingBox(
                x_min=0.2,
                y_min=0.25,
                x_max=0.5,
                y_max=0.75,
                label="Suspect-1",
                category="person",
                confidence=0.94,
            )
        ],
        has_overlay=True,
    )

    inv = Investigation(
        investigation_id="inv-export-vis",
        title="Visual Evidence Export Test",
        objective="Verify visual evidence rendering",
        scope_description="North gate camera scope",
        media_asset_ids=["cam-north"],
    )
    report = Report(
        report_id="rep-vis-01",
        investigation_id="inv-export-vis",
        title="Forensic Deliverable With Visual Evidence",
        summary="Analysis confirmed incident with annotated visual evidence.",
        generated_by="vigil-investigator",
        evidence_frame_artifact_ids=["art-evidence-01"],
        visual_evidence=[evidence_item.model_dump()],
    )

    # 1. HTML Export
    html_out = ReportExporter.export_html(
        investigation=inv,
        report=report,
        events=[],
        observations=[],
        assessments=[],
        coverages=[],
        artifacts=[],
        audit_logs=[],
        media_assets=[],
    )

    assert "Forensic Visual Evidence &amp; Incident Key Frames" in html_out
    assert "Suspect observed breaching north perimeter fence." in html_out
    assert "#perimeter_breach" in html_out
    assert "ent-suspect-01" in html_out
    assert "North Gate Entry" in html_out
    assert "14.5s" in html_out
    assert "Model-Generated Overlay" in html_out

    # 2. Markdown Export
    md_out = ReportExporter.export_markdown(
        investigation=inv,
        report=report,
        events=[],
        observations=[],
        assessments=[],
        coverages=[],
        artifacts=[],
        audit_logs=[],
        media_assets=[],
    )

    assert "## 3. Forensic Visual Evidence & Incident Key Frames" in md_out
    assert "Suspect observed breaching north perimeter fence." in md_out
    assert "`ent-suspect-01`" in md_out
    assert "`AI OVERLAY`" in md_out

    # 3. PDF Export
    pdf_bytes = ReportExporter.export_pdf(
        investigation=inv,
        report=report,
        events=[],
        observations=[],
        assessments=[],
        coverages=[],
        artifacts=[],
        audit_logs=[],
        media_assets=[],
    )

    assert isinstance(pdf_bytes, bytes)
    assert pdf_bytes.startswith(b"%PDF-")
    assert len(pdf_bytes) > 2000

# ==============================================================================
# VIGIL Video Forensics - Environment Configuration Template
# ==============================================================================
# Copy this file to .env and fill in your API keys:
#   cp .env.example .env
#
# Supported Providers
# -------------------
# 1. NVIDIA NIM  ★ Recommended — dual-model setup (VLM + LLM)
#    VLM : Cosmos 3 Nano Reasoner  — video-frame / scene analysis
#    LLM : Nemotron 3 Nano 30B A3B Reasoning  — timeline, Q&A, reports
#    Free hosted trial API key: https://build.nvidia.com
#    Keys start with "nvapi-"
#
# 2. Google Gemini (100% Free Tier with generous limits)
#    Native multimodal: video, audio, images
#    Models: gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-1.5-flash
#    Free API key: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
#
# 3. Groq (Ultra-Fast Inference — 100% Free Tier)
#    Models: openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b, whisper-large-v3
#    Free API key: https://console.groq.com/keys
#
# 4. Ollama (100% Free, Local, Private, Offline)
#    Models: llama3.2-vision, llava, whisper
#    Download & Install: https://ollama.com
#    No API key required!
#
# 5. OpenRouter (Free-tier models available with ':free' tag)
#    Models: google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free
#    Free API key: https://openrouter.ai/keys
# ==============================================================================

# Active LLM Provider: "nvidia_nim", "gemini", "groq", "ollama", "openrouter", or "mock"
# Auto-detected from whichever API key is present when VIGIL_LLM_PROVIDER is unset.
VIGIL_LLM_PROVIDER=nvidia_nim

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NVIDIA_API_KEY=nvapi-your_nvidia_api_key_here

NVIDIA_VLM_MODEL=nvidia/cosmos3-nano-reasoner

NVIDIA_LLM_MODEL=nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning

NVIDIA_LLM_BASE_URL=https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1
NVIDIA_VLM_BASE_URL=https://ai.api.nvidia.com/v1

# Rate-limiting — gap (seconds) between requests to avoid ResourceExhausted 503
# Increase to 3-5 if still seeing 503s under heavy load
VIGIL_NVIDIA_INTER_REQUEST_DELAY=2.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Google Gemini (Recommended fallback for Multimodal Video Forensics)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
